```{r bootstrap, include=FALSE}
source("R/workflow_config.R", local = TRUE)
.smart31_case <- smart31_load_case(params$case_file)
.smart31_years <- smart31_year_values(.smart31_case)

smart31_preflight(.smart31_case, "step3", cfg)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = .smart31_case$project_root)
```

## Global setup

```{r step3-01-global-setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 5.5
)

options(
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE,
  scipen = 999
)

required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "purrr",
  "tibble",
  "ggplot2",
  "scales",
  "openxlsx",
  "readxl",
  "mgcv"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Install the following packages before knitting Step 3: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

if (length(cfg$maximum_F) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F)) ||
    as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F) <= 0) {
  stop("params$maximum_F must be one positive finite value.", call. = FALSE)
}

for (nm in c(
  "baranov_root_tolerance",
  "baranov_zero_catch_fraction",
  "calibration_root_tolerance"
)) {
  value <- as.numeric(cfg[[nm]])
  if (length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value) || value <= 0) {
    stop("params$", nm, " must be one positive finite value.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}

for (nm in c(
  "catch_mass_tolerance_fraction",
  "baranov_reconciliation_tolerance_fraction",
  "partial_f_tolerance_fraction"
)) {
  value <- as.numeric(cfg[[nm]])
  if (length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value) || value <= 0) {
    stop("params$", nm, " must be one positive finite value.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}

for (nm in c("high_F_warning_threshold", "dead_removal_fraction_warning_threshold")) {
  value <- as.numeric(cfg[[nm]])
  if (length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value) || value <= 0) {
    stop("params$", nm, " must be one positive finite value.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}
if (as.numeric(cfg$dead_removal_fraction_warning_threshold) >= 1) {
  stop("params$dead_removal_fraction_warning_threshold must be < 1.", call. = FALSE)
}

calibration_years <- c(
  as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_min),
  as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max),
  as.integer(cfg$calibration_anchor_year)
)

if (anyNA(calibration_years) ||
    calibration_years[[1L]] > calibration_years[[2L]] ||
    calibration_years[[3L]] <= calibration_years[[2L]]) {
  stop(
    "Calibration years must satisfy calibration_year_min <= calibration_year_max < calibration_anchor_year.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (length(cfg$extend_age_profiles_from_step1_models) != 1L ||
    !is.logical(cfg$extend_age_profiles_from_step1_models) ||
    is.na(cfg$extend_age_profiles_from_step1_models)) {
  stop(
    "params$extend_age_profiles_from_step1_models must be TRUE or FALSE.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

for (nm in c("age_depth_modifier_lower", "age_depth_modifier_upper")) {
  value <- as.numeric(cfg[[nm]])
  if (length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value) || value <= 0) {
    stop("params$", nm, " must be one positive finite value.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}
if (as.numeric(cfg$age_depth_modifier_lower) >=
    as.numeric(cfg$age_depth_modifier_upper)) {
  stop(
    "age_depth_modifier_lower must be smaller than age_depth_modifier_upper.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Utilities

```{r step3-02-utilities}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

smart31_stop <- function(...) {
  stop(..., call. = FALSE)
}

normalise_code <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

normalise_cfr <- function(x) {
  token <- normalise_code(x)
  token[token %in% c("", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
  token <- sub("\\.0+$", "", token)

  prefix <- toupper(.smart31_case$reporting$cfr_prefix)
  plain <- sub(paste0("^",prefix), "", token)
  if (any(!is.na(plain) & !grepl("^[0-9]+$",plain)))
    smart31_stop("CFR must be numeric or start with the configured prefix; foreign/ambiguous IDs are rejected.")
  digits <- plain
  digits[is.na(token)] <- NA_character_

  invalid <-
    !is.na(digits) &
    (nchar(digits) == 0L | nchar(digits) > .smart31_case$reporting$cfr_numeric_width)

  if (any(invalid)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "CFR values do not match the configured numeric width. Examples: ",
      paste(utils::head(unique(token[invalid]), 5L), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(digits))
  valid <- !is.na(digits) & nchar(digits) > 0L
  out[valid] <- paste0(
    .smart31_case$reporting$cfr_prefix,
    paste0(vapply(nchar(digits[valid]), function(n) paste(rep("0", .smart31_case$reporting$cfr_numeric_width-n), collapse=""), character(1)), digits[valid])
  )
  out
}

normalise_gsa <- function(x) {
  cleaned <- normalise_code(x)
  token <- sub("^GSA[[:space:]_-]*", "", cleaned)
  token <- gsub(",", ".", token, fixed = TRUE)
  token <- gsub("[[:space:]_-]+", "", token)

  output <- rep(NA_character_, length(token))
  integer_format <- !is.na(token) & grepl("^[0-9]+$", token)

  if (any(integer_format)) {
    value <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(token[integer_format]))
    output[integer_format] <- ifelse(
      value < 100L,
      sprintf("GSA%02d", value),
      paste0("GSA", value)
    )
  }

  decimal_format <- !is.na(token) & grepl("^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", token)
  if (any(decimal_format)) {
    parts <- strsplit(token[decimal_format], "\\.")
    output[decimal_format] <- vapply(
      parts,
      function(z) {
        paste0(
          "GSA",
          sprintf("%02d", as.integer(z[[1L]])),
          paste0(z[-1L], collapse = "")
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
  }

  output
}

as_logical_field <- function(x, label) {
  token <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep(NA, length(token))
  out[token %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")] <- TRUE
  out[token %in% c("false", "f", "0", "no", "n")] <- FALSE
  if (anyNA(out)) {
    smart31_stop(label, " contains values that cannot be read as TRUE/FALSE.")
  }
  out
}

assert_columns <- function(x, required, label) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x)) {
    smart31_stop(label, " is not a data frame.")
  }
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(x))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      label,
      " is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      "."
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

assert_unique <- function(x, keys, label) {
  duplicated_keys <- x %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(keys))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$n > 1L)
  if (nrow(duplicated_keys) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      label,
      " is not unique by ",
      paste(keys, collapse = " × "),
      "."
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

read_delimited_auto <- function(path, label = basename(path)) {
  if (length(path) != 1L || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    smart31_stop(label, " not found: ", path)
  }

  header <- readLines(path, n = 1L, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  if (length(header) != 1L || !nzchar(header)) {
    smart31_stop(label, " has an empty or unreadable header: ", path)
  }

  count_literal <- function(x, token) {
    nchar(x, type = "bytes") - nchar(gsub(token, "", x, fixed = TRUE), type = "bytes")
  }

  separator_counts <- c(
    comma = count_literal(header, ","),
    semicolon = count_literal(header, ";"),
    tab = count_literal(header, "\t")
  )

  if (max(separator_counts) <= 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      label,
      " delimiter could not be detected from the header. Expected comma, semicolon or tab: ",
      path
    )
  }

  sep <- c(comma = ",", semicolon = ";", tab = "\t")[[names(which.max(separator_counts))]]

  out <- utils::read.table(
    path,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = sep,
    quote = "\"",
    comment.char = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    na.strings = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
    strip.white = TRUE,
    fill = FALSE
  )

  attr(out, "detected_separator") <- sep
  out
}

read_contract_csv <- function(path, required_columns, label) {
  out <- read_delimited_auto(path, label)
  assert_columns(out, required_columns, label)
  tibble::as_tibble(out)
}

select_latest_result <- function(directory, pattern, label) {
  candidates <- list.files(
    directory,
    pattern = pattern,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  candidates <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(candidates) == 0L) {
    smart31_stop("No ", label, " was found in ", directory, ".")
  }
  information <- file.info(candidates)
  candidates[[order(information$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)[[1L]]]]
}

resolve_input_path <- function(path, fallback_directory, pattern, label) {
  if (is.null(path)) {
    return(select_latest_result(fallback_directory, pattern, label))
  }
  path <- as.character(path)
  if (length(path) != 1L || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    smart31_stop(label, " not found: ", paste(path, collapse = ", "))
  }
  path
}

select_latest_step2_overview <- function(path = NULL, directories) {
  if (!is.null(path)) {
    path <- as.character(path)
    if (length(path) != 1L || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
      smart31_stop("SMART3.1 Step 2 result not found: ", paste(path, collapse = ", "))
    }
    return(path)
  }

  directories <- unique(as.character(directories))
  directories <- directories[!is.na(directories) & nzchar(directories)]
  pattern <- "^SMART31_step2_simulation_results_[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{6}\\.rds$"

  candidates <- unique(unlist(lapply(directories, function(directory) {
    if (!dir.exists(directory)) return(character())
    list.files(directory, pattern = pattern, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  }), use.names = FALSE))
  candidates <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(candidates)) {

    latest_name <- sort(unique(basename(candidates)), decreasing = TRUE)[[1L]]
    latest <- candidates[basename(candidates) == latest_name]
    if (length(latest) > 1L && length(unique(unname(tools::md5sum(latest)))) != 1L)
      smart31_stop("Different Step 2 files share the latest timestamp. Set step2_result_file explicitly.")
    selected <- normalizePath(latest[[1L]], mustWork = TRUE)
    message("Selected Step 2 overview: ", selected)
    return(selected)
  }

  smart31_stop(
    "No compatible Step 2 overview was found. Searched: ",
    paste(directories, collapse = "; "),
    ". Set params$step2_result_file explicitly if the result is elsewhere."
  )
}

smart31_step2_materialise_details <- function(
  overview_file,
  overview,
  tables = c("catches", "spatial_patterns")
) {
  allowed <- c("catches", "spatial_patterns", "occupancy")
  if (any(!tables %in% allowed)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Unknown Step 2 detail tables requested: ",
      paste(setdiff(tables, allowed), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  present <- vapply(
    tables,
    function(nm) is.data.frame(overview[[nm]]) && nrow(overview[[nm]]) >= 0L,
    logical(1)
  )
  if (all(present)) {
    overview$metadata$step3_detail_source <- "self_contained_step2_result"
    overview$step3_archive_audit <- tibble::tibble(
      run_id = "self_contained", scenario_id = NA_character_, method = NA_character_,
      replicate = NA_integer_, archive_relative = basename(overview_file),
      source_md5_match = TRUE, manifest_identity_match = TRUE,
      byte_count_match = TRUE, detail_tables_present = TRUE,
      archive_ok = TRUE
    )
    return(overview)
  }

  storage_format <- overview$metadata$storage_format %||% NA_character_
  if (!identical(storage_format, "SMART31.partitioned.results.1")) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Step 2 does not expose a recognised partitioned result contract. ",
      "Observed storage_format: ", storage_format, "."
    )
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(overview$run_archives)) {
    smart31_stop("Partitioned Step 2 overview has no run_archives manifest.")
  }
  assert_columns(
    overview$run_archives,
    c("run_id", "scenario_id", "method", "replicate", "feasible", "archive_relative"),
    "Step 2 run-archive manifest"
  )
  assert_unique(overview$run_archives, "run_id", "Step 2 run-archive manifest")
  assert_unique(
    overview$run_archives,
    c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate"),
    "Step 2 run-archive manifest"
  )

  manifest <- overview$run_archives %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$feasible) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate)

  if (!nrow(manifest)) {
    smart31_stop("Step 2 run manifest contains no feasible archive.")
  }

  if (is.data.frame(overview$run_status)) {
    feasible_status <- overview$run_status %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$feasible) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        scenario_id = as.character(.data$scenario_id),
        method = as.character(.data$method),
        replicate = as.integer(.data$replicate)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()
    feasible_manifest <- manifest %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        scenario_id = as.character(.data$scenario_id),
        method = as.character(.data$method),
        replicate = as.integer(.data$replicate)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()
    if (nrow(dplyr::anti_join(feasible_status, feasible_manifest,
                              by = c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate"))) ||
        nrow(dplyr::anti_join(feasible_manifest, feasible_status,
                              by = c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate")))) {
      smart31_stop("Feasible Step 2 run_status and run_archives manifest disagree.")
    }
  }

  chunks <- stats::setNames(lapply(tables, function(x) list()), tables)
  audit_rows <- vector("list", nrow(manifest))
  source_md5 <- as.character(overview$metadata$scientific_source_md5 %||% NA_character_)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(manifest))) {
    archive_file <- file.path(dirname(overview_file), manifest$archive_relative[[i]])
    if (!file.exists(archive_file)) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Missing Step 2 complete run archive: ", archive_file,
        ". Keep the compact overview and per-run archives together."
      )
    }

    observed_bytes <- as.numeric(file.info(archive_file)$size)
    expected_bytes <- if ("bytes" %in% names(manifest)) as.numeric(manifest$bytes[[i]]) else NA_real_
    byte_count_match <- !is.finite(expected_bytes) ||
      abs(observed_bytes - expected_bytes) <= 0.5

    archive <- readRDS(archive_file)
    if (!is.list(archive) || !is.list(archive$metadata) || !is.list(archive$run)) {
      smart31_stop("Invalid Step 2 complete run archive: ", archive_file)
    }

    archive_md5 <- as.character(archive$metadata$scientific_source_md5 %||% NA_character_)
    source_md5_match <- is.na(source_md5) || !nzchar(source_md5) || identical(source_md5, archive_md5)
    if (!source_md5_match) smart31_stop("Step 2 archive/source mismatch: ", archive_file)

    scenario_contract <- archive$metadata$scenario_contract %||% list()
    run <- archive$run
    manifest_identity_match <-
      identical(as.character(scenario_contract$scenario_id %||% manifest$scenario_id[[i]]),
                as.character(manifest$scenario_id[[i]])) &&
      identical(as.character(run$method %||% archive$metadata$method),
                as.character(manifest$method[[i]])) &&
      identical(as.integer(run$replicate %||% archive$metadata$replicate),
                as.integer(manifest$replicate[[i]]))
    if (!manifest_identity_match) {
      smart31_stop("Step 2 archive identity does not match manifest: ", archive_file)
    }

    if (!isTRUE(run$feasible) || !is.list(run$outputs)) {
      smart31_stop("Step 2 archive does not contain one feasible complete run: ", archive_file)
    }

    detail_tables_present <- TRUE
    for (nm in tables) {
      field <- if (nm == "spatial_patterns") "spatial_pattern" else nm
      value <- run$outputs[[field, exact = TRUE]]
      if (!is.data.frame(value)) {
        detail_tables_present <- FALSE
        smart31_stop(
          "Step 2 archive is missing the full detail table '", field,
          "': ", archive_file
        )
      }
      chunks[[nm]][[length(chunks[[nm]]) + 1L]] <- value
    }

    audit_rows[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
      run_id = as.character(manifest$run_id[[i]]),
      scenario_id = as.character(manifest$scenario_id[[i]]),
      method = as.character(manifest$method[[i]]),
      replicate = as.integer(manifest$replicate[[i]]),
      archive_relative = as.character(manifest$archive_relative[[i]]),
      source_md5_match = source_md5_match,
      manifest_identity_match = manifest_identity_match,
      byte_count_match = byte_count_match,
      detail_tables_present = detail_tables_present,
      archive_ok = source_md5_match && manifest_identity_match &&
        byte_count_match && detail_tables_present
    )

    rm(archive, run)
    invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
  }

  for (nm in tables) {
    overview[[nm]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(chunks[[nm]])
  }
  overview$step3_archive_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(audit_rows)
  if (any(!overview$step3_archive_audit$archive_ok)) {
    smart31_stop("At least one Step 2 archive failed the Step 3 interface audit.")
  }
  overview$metadata$materialised_detail_tables <- tables
  overview$metadata$step3_detail_source <- "per_run_archives"
  overview
}

median_or_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::median(x)
}

safe_percent_change <- function(new, reference, tolerance = 1e-12) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.finite(new) & is.finite(reference) & abs(reference) > tolerance,
    100 * (new - reference) / abs(reference),
    NA_real_
  )
}

ensure_columns <- function(x, columns, prototype = NA_real_) {
  for (column in setdiff(columns, names(x))) {
    x[[column]] <- prototype
  }
  x
}

one_value <- function(x, label, tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)) {
  available <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (length(available) == 0L) return(NA)
  if (is.numeric(available)) {
    if (max(available) - min(available) >
        tolerance * max(1, abs(available))) {
      smart31_stop("Non-unique values encountered for ", label, ".")
    }
    return(available[[1L]])
  }
  if (length(available) != 1L) {
    smart31_stop("Non-unique values encountered for ", label, ".")
  }
  available[[1L]]
}

pick_column <- function(df, candidates, required = TRUE, label = "") {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit) == 0L) {
    if (isTRUE(required)) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Unable to identify ", label, ". Expected one of: ",
        paste(candidates, collapse = ", "), "."
      )
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  hit[[1L]]
}

normalise_gsa_parent <- function(x) {
  cleaned <- normalise_code(x)
  token <- sub("^GSA[[:space:]_-]*", "", cleaned)
  token <- gsub(",", ".", token, fixed = TRUE)
  token[token %in% c("111", "112", "11.1", "11.2")] <- "11"
  token <- sub("^([0-9]+)\\..*$", "\\1", token)
  token <- gsub("[[:space:]_-]+", "", token)

  output <- rep(NA_character_, length(token))
  numeric_format <- !is.na(token) & grepl("^[0-9]+$", token)
  if (any(numeric_format)) {
    value <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(token[numeric_format]))
    output[numeric_format] <- ifelse(
      value < 100L,
      sprintf("GSA%02d", value),
      paste0("GSA", value)
    )
  }
  output
}

stopifnot(identical(normalise_gsa_parent(c("GSA11.1", "GSA11.2", "GSA111", "GSA112", "11", "GSA 11.1")),
                    rep("GSA11", 6L)))

safe_min <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) NA_real_ else min(x)
}

safe_max <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) NA_real_ else max(x)
}

g_partial <- function(F_partial, M, F_external) {
  if (!all(is.finite(c(F_partial, M, F_external))) ||
      F_partial < 0 || M < 0 || F_external < 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  if (F_partial == 0) return(0)
  Z <- M + F_external + F_partial
  (F_partial / Z) * (-expm1(-Z))
}

solve_relative_partial_f <- function(
  ratio,
  F_ITA_anchor,
  M,
  F_external,
  maximum_partial_F,
  tolerance
) {
  if (!all(is.finite(c(ratio, F_ITA_anchor, M, F_external))) ||
      ratio < 0 || F_ITA_anchor < 0 || M < 0 || F_external < 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_ITA_future = NA_real_,
      target_g = NA_real_,
      calibration_root_residual = NA_real_,
      calibration_status = "invalid_input"
    ))
  }

  anchor_g <- g_partial(
    F_partial = F_ITA_anchor,
    M = M,
    F_external = F_external
  )

  if (!is.finite(anchor_g)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_ITA_future = NA_real_,
      target_g = NA_real_,
      calibration_root_residual = NA_real_,
      calibration_status = "invalid_anchor_g"
    ))
  }

  target_g <- ratio * anchor_g

  if (target_g == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_ITA_future = 0,
      target_g = 0,
      calibration_root_residual = 0,
      calibration_status = "ok_zero_ratio"
    ))
  }

  if (target_g >= 1) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_ITA_future = NA_real_,
      target_g = target_g,
      calibration_root_residual = NA_real_,
      calibration_status = "target_g_at_or_above_one"
    ))
  }

  objective <- function(F_partial) {
    g_partial(
      F_partial = F_partial,
      M = M,
      F_external = F_external
    ) - target_g
  }

  upper_value <- objective(maximum_partial_F)
  if (!is.finite(upper_value) || upper_value < 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_ITA_future = NA_real_,
      target_g = target_g,
      calibration_root_residual = upper_value,
      calibration_status = "solution_exceeds_maximum_F"
    ))
  }

  root <- tryCatch(
    stats::uniroot(
      objective,
      interval = c(0, maximum_partial_F),
      tol = tolerance,
      maxiter = 1000L
    )$root,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  if (!is.finite(root)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_ITA_future = NA_real_,
      target_g = target_g,
      calibration_root_residual = NA_real_,
      calibration_status = "root_finding_failed"
    ))
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    F_ITA_future = root,
    target_g = target_g,
    calibration_root_residual = objective(root),
    calibration_status = "ok"
  )
}

atomic_save_rds <- function(x, path) {
  temporary <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(basename(path), "_"),
    tmpdir = dirname(path),
    fileext = ".tmp"
  )
  on.exit(if (file.exists(temporary)) unlink(temporary), add = TRUE)
  saveRDS(x, temporary, compress = "gzip", version = 3)
  if (!file.rename(temporary, path)) {
    smart31_stop("Unable to publish RDS output: ", path)
  }
  invisible(path)
}

atomic_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
  temporary <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(basename(path), "_"),
    tmpdir = dirname(path),
    fileext = ".tmp"
  )
  on.exit(if (file.exists(temporary)) unlink(temporary), add = TRUE)
  utils::write.csv(x, temporary, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  if (!file.rename(temporary, path)) {
    smart31_stop("Unable to publish CSV output: ", path)
  }
  invisible(path)
}
```

## Load smart results

```{r step3-03-load-smart-results}

step2_result_file <- select_latest_step2_overview(
  cfg$step2_result_file,
  cfg$step2_search_directories
)

if (!is.finite(as.numeric(cfg$step2_overview_max_mib)) ||
    as.numeric(cfg$step2_overview_max_mib) <= 0) {
  smart31_stop("params$step2_overview_max_mib must be positive.")
}

if (file.info(step2_result_file)$size >
    as.numeric(cfg$step2_overview_max_mib) * 1024^2) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The selected Step 2 file is larger than the overview guard (",
    cfg$step2_overview_max_mib,
    " MiB). Select the compact partitioned overview, not an old all-detail master."
  )
}

step2_overview <- readRDS(step2_result_file)
if (!is.list(step2_overview) || !is.list(step2_overview$metadata)) {
  smart31_stop("The selected Step 2 file is not a valid SMART result overview.")
}

smart31_validate_step2_policy(step2_overview, .smart31_case)

required_step2_overview_objects <- c(
  "metadata", "run_status", "economic_annual"
)
missing_step2_overview_objects <- setdiff(
  required_step2_overview_objects,
  names(step2_overview)
)
if (length(missing_step2_overview_objects) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The Step 2 overview is missing: ",
    paste(missing_step2_overview_objects, collapse = ", "),
    "."
  )
}

step2_export <- smart31_step2_materialise_details(
  overview_file = step2_result_file,
  overview = step2_overview,
  tables = c("catches", "spatial_patterns")
)
rm(step2_overview)
invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

assert_columns(
  step2_export$run_status,
  c(
    "scenario_id", "scenario_year", "representative_period",
    "member_state", "method", "replicate", "feasible", "converged"
  ),
  "Step 2 run_status"
)

eligible_run_status <- step2_export$run_status %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$feasible,
    isTRUE(cfg$include_feasible_nonconverged) | .data$converged
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    scenario_id = as.character(.data$scenario_id),
    representative_period = as.character(.data$representative_period),
    member_state = normalise_code(.data$member_state),
    method = as.character(.data$method),
    replicate = as.integer(.data$replicate)
  )

if (nrow(eligible_run_status) == 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Step 2 contains no eligible feasible run. Inspect its run_status table."
  )
}

if (any(eligible_run_status$member_state != .smart31_case$domain$country)) {
  smart31_stop("Step 3 accepts only the member state configured for this case.")
}

contract_summary_method <- trimws(as.character(
  cfg$contract_summary_method
))

if (length(contract_summary_method) != 1L ||
    is.na(contract_summary_method) ||
    !nzchar(contract_summary_method) ||
    !contract_summary_method %in% eligible_run_status$method) {
  smart31_stop(
    "params$contract_summary_method must identify one eligible Step 2 method. ",
    "Available methods: ",
    paste(sort(unique(eligible_run_status$method)), collapse = ", "),
    "."
  )
}

run_keys <- c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate")
assert_unique(eligible_run_status, run_keys, "Eligible Step 2 run status")

scenario_crosswalk <- tibble::tribble(
  ~scenario_id, ~contract_scenario_code, ~contract_interpretation,
  .smart31_case$scenario_ids$baseline, .smart31_case$scenario_codes$baseline, "Configured baseline",
  .smart31_case$scenario_ids$A, "A", "Management alternative A",
  .smart31_case$scenario_ids$B, "B", "Management alternative B"
)

eligible_run_status <- eligible_run_status %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scenario_crosswalk,
    by = "scenario_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

unmapped_scenarios <- eligible_run_status %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$contract_scenario_code)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$scenario_id)

if (nrow(unmapped_scenarios) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Step 2 contains scenario identifiers not recognised by Step 3: ",
    paste(unmapped_scenarios$scenario_id, collapse = ", "),
    "."
  )
}

step2_interface_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  step2_result_file = normalizePath(step2_result_file),
  source_document = as.character(step2_export$metadata$source_document %||% NA_character_),
  scientific_revision = as.character(step2_export$metadata$scientific_revision %||% NA_character_),
  storage_format = as.character(step2_export$metadata$storage_format %||% "self_contained_legacy"),
  detail_source = as.character(step2_export$metadata$step3_detail_source %||% NA_character_),
  other_gvl_mode = as.character(step2_export$metadata$other_gvl_mode %||% NA_character_),
  other_gvl_beta = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(step2_export$metadata$other_gvl_beta %||% NA_real_)),
  other_gvl_cap_at_reference = as.logical(step2_export$metadata$other_gvl_cap_at_reference %||% NA),
  maximum_sweeps = suppressWarnings(as.integer(step2_export$metadata$maximum_sweeps %||% NA_integer_)),
  lpue_response_mode = as.character(step2_export$metadata$lpue_response_mode %||% NA_character_),
  simulation_lpue_mode = as.character(step2_export$configuration$simulation_lpue_mode %||% NA_character_),
  crowding_definition = as.character(step2_export$metadata$crowding_definition %||% NA_character_),
  eligible_runs = nrow(eligible_run_status),
  contract_summary_method = contract_summary_method
)

step1_candidate <- cfg$step1_bundle_file %||%
  step2_export$metadata$step1_bundle_file

if (is.null(step1_candidate) || !file.exists(step1_candidate)) {
  step1_candidate <- select_latest_result(
    file.path("outputs", "step1_simulation_inputs"),
    "^SMART31_step1_simulation_inputs_.*\\.rds$",
    "SMART3.1 Step 1 bundle"
  )
}

step1_bundle_file <- step1_candidate
step1_bundle <- readRDS(step1_bundle_file)

if (!is.list(step1_bundle) || !is.list(step1_bundle$inputs)) {
  smart31_stop("The selected Step 1 file is not a valid simulation bundle.")
}

step1_inputs <- step1_bundle$inputs
step1_diagnostics <- step1_bundle$diagnostics %||% list()
step1_age_depth_models <- step1_diagnostics$age_depth_models %||%
  step1_inputs$age_depth_models %||% NULL
step1_source_rmd <- as.character(
  step1_bundle$metadata$source_rmd %||% NA_character_
)

required_step1_objects <- c(
  "age_proportions",
  "stock_parameters",
  "grid_sf",
  "IBM",
  "IBM.eco.annual",
  "final_fleet"
)

missing_step1_objects <- setdiff(required_step1_objects, names(step1_inputs))
if (length(missing_step1_objects) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Regenerate Step 1 with run_age_module <- TRUE. Missing objects: ",
    paste(missing_step1_objects, collapse = ", "),
    "."
  )
}

configured_step1_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(step1_bundle_file))
expected_step1_md5 <- step2_export$metadata$step1_bundle_md5 %||% NA_character_
controlled_step1_md5 <- as.character(cfg$expected_step1_bundle_md5 %||% NA_character_)

if (length(controlled_step1_md5) == 1L &&
    !is.na(controlled_step1_md5) &&
    nzchar(controlled_step1_md5) &&
    !identical(configured_step1_md5, controlled_step1_md5)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The selected Step 1 bundle does not match the controlled bundle. ",
    "Expected MD5: ", controlled_step1_md5,
    "; observed MD5: ", configured_step1_md5, "."
  )
}

if (length(expected_step1_md5) == 1L &&
    !is.na(expected_step1_md5) &&
    nzchar(expected_step1_md5) &&
    !identical(configured_step1_md5, expected_step1_md5)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The selected Step 1 bundle does not match the bundle used by Step 2. ",
    "Expected MD5: ", expected_step1_md5,
    "; observed MD5: ", configured_step1_md5, "."
  )
}

cat(
  "SMART inputs loaded:\n",
  "  Step 2: ", normalizePath(step2_result_file), "\n",
  "  Step 2 source: ", step2_interface_audit$source_document, "\n",
  "  Step 2 detail source: ", step2_interface_audit$detail_source, "\n",
  "  eligible runs: ", nrow(eligible_run_status), "\n",
  "  contract summary method: ", contract_summary_method, "\n",
  "  Step 1: ", normalizePath(step1_bundle_file), "\n",
  "  Step 1 MD5: ", configured_step1_md5, "\n",
  "  Step 1 source: ", step1_source_rmd, "\n",
  sep = ""
)

smart31_kable(
  step2_interface_audit,
  caption = "Step 2 interface detected by Step 3"
)
```

```{r step3-05-load-stock-parameters}
invalid_reference_points <- stock_reference_points %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fbar_one_missing = xor(is.na(.data$Fbar_age_min), is.na(.data$Fbar_age_max)),
    fbar_invalid = (!is.na(.data$Fbar_age_min) & .data$Fbar_age_min < 0L) |
      (!is.na(.data$Fbar_age_min) & !is.na(.data$Fbar_age_max) &
         .data$Fbar_age_max < .data$Fbar_age_min),
    fmsy_invalid = !is.na(.data$Fmsy) &
      (!is.finite(.data$Fmsy) | .data$Fmsy <= 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(.data$stock_id) | !nzchar(.data$stock_id) |
      is.na(.data$stock_label) | !nzchar(.data$stock_label) |
      .data$fbar_one_missing | .data$fbar_invalid | .data$fmsy_invalid
  )

if (nrow(invalid_reference_points) > 0L) {
  print(invalid_reference_points)
  smart31_stop("Stock reference points contain malformed supplied values.")
}

reference_point_availability <- stock_reference_points %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$stock_id, .data$stock_label,
    Fbar_age_range_available = !is.na(.data$Fbar_age_min) & !is.na(.data$Fbar_age_max),
    Fmsy_available = is.finite(.data$Fmsy) & .data$Fmsy > 0,
    Bpa_available = is.finite(.data$Bpa_t) & .data$Bpa_t > 0,
    Blim_available = is.finite(.data$Blim_t) & .data$Blim_t > 0
  )

reference_point_provenance <- tibble::tibble(
  stock_id = character(), assessment_stock = character(), source_file = character(),
  Fbar_age_min = integer(), Fbar_age_max = integer(), scope_note = character(),
  numeric_reference_points_found_in_source = character()
)
if (!is.null(cfg$stock_reference_points_provenance_file) &&
    length(cfg$stock_reference_points_provenance_file) == 1L &&
    !is.na(cfg$stock_reference_points_provenance_file) &&
    file.exists(cfg$stock_reference_points_provenance_file)) {
  reference_point_provenance <- read_delimited_auto(
    cfg$stock_reference_points_provenance_file,
    "Stock reference-point provenance"
  ) %>% tibble::as_tibble()
}

if (!isTRUE(cfg$allow_missing_reference_points) &&
    any(!reference_point_availability$Fbar_age_range_available |
        !reference_point_availability$Fmsy_available)) {
  print(reference_point_availability)
  smart31_stop(
    "Every stock requires Fbar ages and Fmsy when ",
    "allow_missing_reference_points is FALSE."
  )
}

crosswalk_stock_ids <- sort(unique(stock_area_crosswalk$stock_id))
missing_stock_references <- setdiff(
  crosswalk_stock_ids,
  stock_reference_points$stock_id
)
if (length(missing_stock_references) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Missing reference-point rows for stocks: ",
    paste(missing_stock_references, collapse = ", "),
    "."
  )
}

expected_stock_periods <- tidyr::crossing(
  stock_id = crosswalk_stock_ids,
  representative_period = valid_periods
)

missing_stock_periods <- expected_stock_periods %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    stock_age_parameters %>%
      dplyr::distinct(.data$stock_id, .data$representative_period),
    by = c("stock_id", "representative_period")
  )

if (nrow(missing_stock_periods) > 0L) {
  print(missing_stock_periods)
  smart31_stop("Stock-age parameters do not cover both representative periods.")
}
```

## Load assessment calibration inputs

```{r step3-06-load-assessment-calibration-inputs}
required_assessment_files <- c(

assessment_stock_crosswalk <- read_contract_csv(

    GSA_code = normalise_gsa(.data$GSA_code),
    assessment_stock = trimws(as.character(.data$assessment_stock)),

    assessment_scope = as.character(.data$assessment_scope),
    smart_scope_components = as.character(.data$smart_scope_components),

assert_unique(

assert_unique(

)

assessment_crosswalk_consistency <- stock_area_crosswalk %>%
  dplyr::filter(!.data$stock_id %in% .smart31_case$reporting$catch_only_stock_ids) %>%

    .data$stock_id, .data$stock_label,

        .data$assessment_stock,

  dplyr::mutate(

      .data$stock_label == .data$assessment_stock_label &
      .data$Species == .data$assessment_Species &

      !is.na(.data$assessment_stock)

if (anyNA(assessment_crosswalk_consistency$consistent) ||

if (!setequal(

)

assessment_share_coverage <- tidyr::expand_grid(

if (anyNA(assessment_share_coverage$valid) ||

assessment_F_history_coverage <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  assessment_stock = expected_assessment_stocks,

) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    assessment_history %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$assessment_stock, .data$Year) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_age_rows = dplyr::n(),
        all_F_finite_nonnegative =
          all(is.finite(.data$F_total_assessment) &

  dplyr::mutate(
    valid =
      is.finite(.data$n_age_rows) &

      .data$all_F_finite_nonnegative &
      .data$all_M_finite_nonnegative
  )

if (anyNA(assessment_F_history_coverage$valid) ||
    any(!assessment_F_history_coverage$valid)) {
  print(assessment_F_history_coverage)
  smart31_stop(

}

assessment_reference_legacy <- assessment_stock_crosswalk %>%

assessment_reference_points <- assessment_anchor_2025 %>%
```

## Allocate catch to age

```{r step3-07-allocate-catch-to-age}

assert_columns(
  step2_export$catches,
  c(
    "scenario_id", "scenario_year", "representative_period",
    "member_state", "method", "replicate", "MONTH", "Gear", "Metier",
    "id_grid", "GSA_code", "Species", "W", "simulation_treatment"
  ),
  "Step 2 catches"
)

assert_columns(
  step1_inputs$age_proportions,
  c(
    "GSA_code", "Species", "id_grid", "Age", "age_proportion",
    "baseline_proportion", "baseline_source"
  ),
  "Step 1 age_proportions"
)

eligible_catches <- step2_export$catches %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(eligible_run_status, by = run_keys) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    scenario_id = as.character(.data$scenario_id),
    scenario_year = as.integer(.data$scenario_year),
    representative_period = as.character(.data$representative_period),
    member_state = normalise_code(.data$member_state),
    method = as.character(.data$method),
    replicate = as.integer(.data$replicate),
    CFR = if ("CFR" %in% names(step2_export$catches)) {
      as.character(.data$CFR)
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    MONTH = as.integer(.data$MONTH),
    Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
    Metier = normalise_code(.data$Metier),
    id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
    GSA_code = normalise_gsa(.data$GSA_code),
    Species = normalise_code(.data$Species),
    landed_weight_kg = as.numeric(.data$W),
    simulation_treatment = as.character(.data$simulation_treatment)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scenario_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$scenario_id, .data$contract_scenario_code),
    by = "scenario_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(catch_row_id = dplyr::row_number(), .before = 1)

if (nrow(eligible_catches) == 0L) {
  smart31_stop("Eligible Step 2 runs contain no catch rows.")
}

if (any(!is.finite(eligible_catches$landed_weight_kg)) ||
    any(eligible_catches$landed_weight_kg < 0)) {
  smart31_stop("Step 2 catches contain invalid catch weights.")
}

step2_archive_audit <- step2_export$step3_archive_audit %||% tibble::tibble()
if (nrow(step2_archive_audit) && any(!step2_archive_audit$archive_ok)) {
  smart31_stop("Step 2 per-run archives failed the interface audit.")
}

step2_archive_catch_totals <- eligible_catches %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    archive_estimated_catch_kg = sum(.data$landed_weight_kg),
    archive_fixed_non_vms_catch_kg = sum(
      .data$landed_weight_kg[
        .data$simulation_treatment ==
          "fixed_non_vms_catch_no_synthetic_effort_or_economics"
      ]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

step2_archive_catch_reconciliation <- step2_archive_catch_totals
if (is.data.frame(step2_export$catch_summary) && nrow(step2_export$catch_summary)) {
  assert_columns(
    step2_export$catch_summary,
    c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate", "estimated_catch_kg", "fixed_non_vms_catch_kg"),
    "Step 2 catch summary"
  )
  step2_archive_catch_reconciliation <- step2_archive_catch_totals %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      step2_export$catch_summary %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          scenario_id = as.character(.data$scenario_id),
          method = as.character(.data$method),
          replicate = as.integer(.data$replicate),
          overview_estimated_catch_kg = as.numeric(.data$estimated_catch_kg),
          overview_fixed_non_vms_catch_kg = as.numeric(.data$fixed_non_vms_catch_kg)
        ),
      by = c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate"),
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      catch_difference_kg = .data$archive_estimated_catch_kg - .data$overview_estimated_catch_kg,
      fixed_non_vms_difference_kg = .data$archive_fixed_non_vms_catch_kg -
        .data$overview_fixed_non_vms_catch_kg,
      catch_reconciled = is.finite(.data$overview_estimated_catch_kg) &
        abs(.data$catch_difference_kg) <=
          as.numeric(cfg$catch_mass_tolerance_fraction) *
          pmax(1, abs(.data$overview_estimated_catch_kg)),
      fixed_non_vms_reconciled = is.finite(.data$overview_fixed_non_vms_catch_kg) &
        abs(.data$fixed_non_vms_difference_kg) <=
          as.numeric(cfg$catch_mass_tolerance_fraction) *
          pmax(1, abs(.data$overview_fixed_non_vms_catch_kg)),
      reconciled = .data$catch_reconciled & .data$fixed_non_vms_reconciled
    )
  if (anyNA(step2_archive_catch_reconciliation$reconciled) ||
      any(!step2_archive_catch_reconciliation$reconciled)) {
    smart31_stop("Step 2 archive catch totals do not reconcile with the compact overview.")
  }
}

catch_stock_mapping <- eligible_catches %>%
  dplyr::mutate(stock_GSA_parent = normalise_gsa_parent(.data$GSA_code)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_area_crosswalk,
    by = c("Species", "stock_GSA_parent" = "GSA_code"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

unmapped_catch_diagnostic <- catch_stock_mapping %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$landed_weight_kg > 0, is.na(.data$stock_id)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$Species, .data$GSA_code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    unmapped_landed_weight_kg = sum(.data$landed_weight_kg),
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mapped_catches <- catch_stock_mapping %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$stock_id))

age_profiles_exact <- step1_inputs$age_proportions %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    GSA_code = normalise_gsa(.data$GSA_code),
    Species = normalise_code(.data$Species),
    id_grid = as.character(.data$id_grid),
    Age = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(.data$Age))),
    age_proportion = as.numeric(.data$age_proportion),
    baseline_proportion = as.numeric(.data$baseline_proportion),
    baseline_source = as.character(.data$baseline_source),
    step1_depth_m = if ("depth" %in% names(step1_inputs$age_proportions)) {
      abs(as.numeric(.data$depth))
    } else NA_real_,
    step1_depth_used_m = if ("depth_used_m" %in% names(step1_inputs$age_proportions)) {
      as.numeric(.data$depth_used_m)
    } else NA_real_,
    step1_estimation_source = if ("estimation_source" %in% names(step1_inputs$age_proportions)) {
      as.character(.data$estimation_source)
    } else NA_character_,
    step1_depth_model_key = if ("depth_model_key" %in% names(step1_inputs$age_proportions)) {
      as.character(.data$depth_model_key)
    } else NA_character_
  )

if (anyNA(age_profiles_exact[c("GSA_code", "Species", "id_grid", "Age")])) {
  smart31_stop("Step 1 age_proportions contains invalid profile keys after normalisation.")
}

assert_unique(
  age_profiles_exact,
  c("GSA_code", "Species", "id_grid", "Age"),
  "Step 1 age proportions"
)

exact_age_profile_check <- age_profiles_exact %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ages = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Age),
    age_sum = sum(.data$age_proportion),
    valid = all(is.finite(.data$age_proportion)) &&
      all(.data$age_proportion >= 0) &&
      abs(sum(.data$age_proportion) - 1) <= 1e-8,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(!exact_age_profile_check$valid)) {
  smart31_stop("The serialized Step 1 exact age profiles are not valid unit-sum vectors.")
}

baseline_consistency <- age_profiles_exact %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Age) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    baseline_min = min(.data$baseline_proportion),
    baseline_max = max(.data$baseline_proportion),
    n_baseline_sources = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$baseline_source),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    baseline_consistent =
      is.finite(.data$baseline_min) & is.finite(.data$baseline_max) &
      .data$baseline_min > 0 &
      abs(.data$baseline_max - .data$baseline_min) <=
        1e-10 * pmax(1, abs(.data$baseline_min)) &
      .data$n_baseline_sources == 1L
  )

if (any(!baseline_consistency$baseline_consistent)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The Step 1 marginal age composition is not uniquely recoverable by Species x GSA x Age."
  )
}

step1_age_baseline_by_area <- age_profiles_exact %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Age) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    baseline_proportion = dplyr::first(.data$baseline_proportion),
    baseline_source = dplyr::first(.data$baseline_source),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

commercial_baseline_by_area <- commercial_age_baseline %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_area_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$stock_id, .data$Species, .data$GSA_code) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = "stock_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

commercial_baseline_by_area <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  commercial_baseline_by_area,
  commercial_baseline_by_area %>% dplyr::filter(.data$GSA_code == "GSA11") %>% dplyr::mutate(GSA_code="GSA111"),
  commercial_baseline_by_area %>% dplyr::filter(.data$GSA_code == "GSA11") %>% dplyr::mutate(GSA_code="GSA112"))
if (anyNA(commercial_baseline_by_area[c("Species", "GSA_code")])) {
  smart31_stop(
    "At least one stock in commercial_age_baseline is absent from the stock-area crosswalk."
  )
}

commercial_override_areas <- commercial_baseline_by_area %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species)

age_baseline_by_area <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  step1_age_baseline_by_area %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      commercial_override_areas,
      by = c("GSA_code", "Species")
    ),
  commercial_baseline_by_area %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Age,
      .data$baseline_proportion,
      baseline_source = paste0("commercial catch override: ", .data$baseline_source)
    )
)

baseline_sum_check <- age_baseline_by_area %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_baseline_ages = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Age),
    baseline_sum = sum(.data$baseline_proportion),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    baseline_valid = .data$n_baseline_ages > 0L &
      is.finite(.data$baseline_sum) &
      abs(.data$baseline_sum - 1) <= 1e-8
  )

if (any(!baseline_sum_check$baseline_valid)) {
  smart31_stop("Effective marginal age compositions do not sum to one.")
}

grid_geometry_age <- if (
  is.list(step1_inputs$grid_sf) && "grid_sf" %in% names(step1_inputs$grid_sf)
) {
  step1_inputs$grid_sf$grid_sf
} else {
  step1_inputs$grid_sf
}

grid_plain_age <- as.data.frame(grid_geometry_age)
if (!all(c("id_grid", "depth") %in% names(grid_plain_age))) {
  smart31_stop("Step 1 grid_sf does not contain id_grid and depth for age-profile reconstruction.")
}

grid_depth_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  id_grid = trimws(as.character(grid_plain_age[["id_grid"]])),
  depth_m = abs(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(grid_plain_age[["depth"]])))
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$id_grid), nzchar(.data$id_grid),
    is.finite(.data$depth_m), .data$depth_m > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$id_grid, .keep_all = TRUE)

requested_profile_cells <- mapped_catches %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$landed_weight_kg > 0) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid)

retained_exact_age_profiles <- age_profiles_exact %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    commercial_override_areas,
    by = c("GSA_code", "Species")
  )

retained_exact_profile_cells <- retained_exact_age_profiles %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid)

commercial_override_cells <- requested_profile_cells %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(
    commercial_override_areas,
    by = c("GSA_code", "Species")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(profile_reconstruction_reason = "commercial_catch_baseline_override")

missing_exact_nonoverride_cells <- requested_profile_cells %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    commercial_override_areas,
    by = c("GSA_code", "Species")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    retained_exact_profile_cells,
    by = c("GSA_code", "Species", "id_grid")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(profile_reconstruction_reason = "missing_exact_step1_profile")

model_profile_cells <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  commercial_override_cells,
  missing_exact_nonoverride_cells
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid, .keep_all = TRUE)

age_profile_extension_cell_audit <- model_profile_cells %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_sum_check %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$GSA_code, .data$Species,
        .data$n_baseline_ages, .data$baseline_valid
      ),
    by = c("GSA_code", "Species"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    grid_depth_lookup,
    by = "id_grid",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    extension_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !isTRUE(cfg$extend_age_profiles_from_step1_models) ~ "extension_disabled",
      is.na(.data$n_baseline_ages) | !dplyr::coalesce(.data$baseline_valid, FALSE) ~
        "unresolved_no_effective_species_gsa_age_baseline",
      !is.finite(.data$depth_m) | .data$depth_m <= 0 ~
        "unresolved_missing_or_invalid_grid_depth",
      TRUE ~ "eligible_for_step1_age_model_reconstruction"
    )
  )

extension_needed <- any(
  age_profile_extension_cell_audit$extension_status ==
    "eligible_for_step1_age_model_reconstruction"
)

if (extension_needed &&
    (!is.list(step1_age_depth_models) || length(step1_age_depth_models) == 0L)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Step 3 needs the serialized Step 1 age_depth_models for profile reconstruction, ",
    "but they are absent from the exact Step 1 bundle diagnostics. No substitute model is used."
  )
}

smart31_predict_step1_age_modifier <- function(data, key) {
  current_gsa <- as.character(key$GSA_code[[1L]])
  current_species <- as.character(key$Species[[1L]])
  current_age <- as.integer(key$Age[[1L]])

  preferred_key <- paste(current_gsa, current_species, current_age, sep = "|")
  pooled_gsa11_key <- paste("GSA11", current_species, current_age, sep = "|")

  preferred_entry <- step1_age_depth_models[[preferred_key]]
  preferred_supported <- is.list(preferred_entry) &&
    identical(as.character(preferred_entry$status), "gsa_depth_gam")

  pooled_entry <- step1_age_depth_models[[pooled_gsa11_key]]
  pooled_supported <- is.list(pooled_entry) &&
    identical(as.character(pooled_entry$status), "gsa_depth_gam")

  selected_key <- preferred_key
  model_source <- "constant_no_supported_depth_model"

  if (preferred_supported) {
    selected_entry <- preferred_entry
    model_source <- "GSA-specific depth GAM"
  } else if (current_gsa %in% c("GSA111", "GSA112") && pooled_supported) {
    selected_key <- pooled_gsa11_key
    selected_entry <- pooled_entry
    model_source <- "pooled GSA11 depth GAM"
  } else if (is.list(preferred_entry)) {
    selected_entry <- preferred_entry
  } else {
    selected_entry <- list(
      status = "constant_no_serialized_depth_model",
      model = NULL,
      reference_prediction = 1,
      depth_min_m = min(data$depth_m),
      depth_max_m = max(data$depth_m),
      n_total_hauls = 0L,
      n_positive_hauls = 0L,
      n_positive_depths = 0L
    )
  }

  selected_model <- selected_entry$model %||% NULL
  n_total_hauls <- as.integer(selected_entry$n_total_hauls %||% 0L)
  n_positive_hauls <- as.integer(selected_entry$n_positive_hauls %||% 0L)
  n_positive_depths <- as.integer(selected_entry$n_positive_depths %||% 0L)

  if (!is.null(selected_model)) {
    depth_min_m <- as.numeric(selected_entry$depth_min_m %||% NA_real_)
    depth_max_m <- as.numeric(selected_entry$depth_max_m %||% NA_real_)
    reference_prediction <- as.numeric(
      selected_entry$reference_prediction %||% NA_real_
    )

    if (!is.finite(depth_min_m) || !is.finite(depth_max_m) ||
        depth_min_m <= 0 || depth_max_m < depth_min_m ||
        !is.finite(reference_prediction) || reference_prediction <= 0) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Invalid serialized Step 1 age-depth model metadata for ", selected_key, "."
      )
    }

    prediction_depth <- pmax(
      depth_min_m,
      pmin(depth_max_m, data$depth_m)
    )

    predicted_density <- tryCatch(
      as.numeric(stats::predict(
        selected_model,
        newdata = data.frame(log_depth = log1p(prediction_depth)),
        type = "response"
      )),
      error = function(e) {
        smart31_stop(
          "Serialized Step 1 age-depth model prediction failed for ",
          selected_key, ": ", conditionMessage(e)
        )
      }
    )

    if (length(predicted_density) != nrow(data) ||
        any(!is.finite(predicted_density)) ||
        any(predicted_density <= 0)) {
      smart31_stop(
        "Serialized Step 1 age-depth model produced invalid predictions for ",
        selected_key, "."
      )
    }

    depth_modifier <- predicted_density / reference_prediction
    depth_modifier <- pmax(
      as.numeric(cfg$age_depth_modifier_lower),
      pmin(
        as.numeric(cfg$age_depth_modifier_upper),
        depth_modifier
      )
    )
  } else {
    prediction_depth <- data$depth_m
    depth_modifier <- rep(1, nrow(data))
  }

  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      depth_used_m = prediction_depth,
      depth_modifier = depth_modifier,
      depth_model_source = model_source,
      depth_model_key = selected_key,
      n_supporting_hauls = n_total_hauls,
      n_positive_supporting_hauls = n_positive_hauls,
      n_positive_supporting_depths = n_positive_depths
    )
}

eligible_extension_cells <- age_profile_extension_cell_audit %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$extension_status == "eligible_for_step1_age_model_reconstruction"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid, .data$depth_m,
    .data$profile_reconstruction_reason
  )

if (nrow(eligible_extension_cells) > 0L) {
  extension_profile_template <- eligible_extension_cells %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      age_baseline_by_area,
      by = c("GSA_code", "Species"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    )

  extended_age_profiles <- extension_profile_template %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Age) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(
      ~ smart31_predict_step1_age_modifier(.x, .y)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      unnormalised_age_weight = .data$baseline_proportion * .data$depth_modifier
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      age_proportion = .data$unnormalised_age_weight /
        sum(.data$unnormalised_age_weight),
      age_profile_source = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$profile_reconstruction_reason == "commercial_catch_baseline_override",
        "commercial_catch_baseline_with_step1_depth_model",
        "step1_age_model_extended_to_step2_catch_support"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
} else {
  extended_age_profiles <- tibble::tibble(
    GSA_code = character(), Species = character(), id_grid = character(),
    Age = integer(), depth_m = numeric(), profile_reconstruction_reason = character(),
    baseline_proportion = numeric(), baseline_source = character(),
    depth_used_m = numeric(), depth_modifier = numeric(), depth_model_source = character(),
    depth_model_key = character(), n_supporting_hauls = integer(),
    n_positive_supporting_hauls = integer(), n_positive_supporting_depths = integer(),
    unnormalised_age_weight = numeric(), age_proportion = numeric(),
    age_profile_source = character()
  )
}

age_profile_extension_audit <- extended_age_profiles %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid,
    .data$profile_reconstruction_reason
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ages = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Age),
    age_sum = sum(.data$age_proportion),
    minimum_age_proportion = min(.data$age_proportion),
    maximum_age_proportion = max(.data$age_proportion),
    minimum_depth_modifier = min(.data$depth_modifier),
    maximum_depth_modifier = max(.data$depth_modifier),
    n_depth_gam_ages = sum(
      .data$depth_model_source %in%
        c("GSA-specific depth GAM", "pooled GSA11 depth GAM")
    ),
    extension_vector_valid =
      all(is.finite(.data$age_proportion)) &&
      all(.data$age_proportion >= 0) &&
      abs(sum(.data$age_proportion) - 1) <= 1e-8,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(age_profile_extension_audit) > 0L &&
    any(!age_profile_extension_audit$extension_vector_valid)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "At least one Step 1 age-model reconstruction produced an invalid age vector."
  )
}

extended_profile_cells <- extended_age_profiles %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid,
    .data$profile_reconstruction_reason
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(profile_created = TRUE)

age_profile_extension_cell_audit <- age_profile_extension_cell_audit %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    extended_profile_cells,
    by = c(
      "GSA_code", "Species", "id_grid", "profile_reconstruction_reason"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    profile_created = dplyr::coalesce(.data$profile_created, FALSE),
    extension_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$extension_status == "eligible_for_step1_age_model_reconstruction" &
        .data$profile_created &
        .data$profile_reconstruction_reason == "commercial_catch_baseline_override" ~
          "reconstructed_from_commercial_baseline_and_step1_depth_model",
      .data$extension_status == "eligible_for_step1_age_model_reconstruction" &
        .data$profile_created ~ "extended_from_serialized_step1_age_model",
      .data$extension_status == "eligible_for_step1_age_model_reconstruction" &
        !.data$profile_created ~ "internal_reconstruction_failure",
      TRUE ~ .data$extension_status
    )
  )

if (any(age_profile_extension_cell_audit$extension_status ==
        "internal_reconstruction_failure")) {
  smart31_stop("An eligible age-profile reconstruction cell was not materialised.")
}

age_profiles_effective <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  retained_exact_age_profiles %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid, .data$Age,
      .data$age_proportion,
      age_profile_source = "step1_exact_lpue_cell"
    ),
  extended_age_profiles %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid, .data$Age,
      .data$age_proportion,
      .data$age_profile_source
    )
)

assert_unique(
  age_profiles_effective,
  c("GSA_code", "Species", "id_grid", "Age"),
  "Effective Step 3 age profiles"
)

effective_age_profile_check <- age_profiles_effective %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$id_grid) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    age_profile_source = one_value(.data$age_profile_source, "age-profile source"),
    n_ages = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Age),
    age_sum = sum(.data$age_proportion),
    valid = all(is.finite(.data$age_proportion)) &&
      all(.data$age_proportion >= 0) &&
      abs(sum(.data$age_proportion) - 1) <= 1e-8,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(!effective_age_profile_check$valid)) {
  smart31_stop("The effective Step 3 age profiles are not valid unit-sum vectors.")
}

catch_age_join <- mapped_catches %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    age_profiles_effective,
    by = c("GSA_code", "Species", "id_grid"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

age_allocation_audit <- catch_age_join %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$catch_row_id, .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, .data$Species, .data$GSA_code, .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    landed_weight_kg = one_value(
      .data$landed_weight_kg,
      "catch-row landed weight"
    ),
    age_profile_source = one_value(
      .data$age_profile_source,
      "catch-row age-profile source"
    ),
    n_ages = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_sum = sum(.data$age_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    age_allocation_ok = .data$n_ages > 0L &
      !is.na(.data$age_profile_source) &
      abs(.data$age_sum - 1) <= 1e-8
  )

missing_age_profile_diagnostic <- age_allocation_audit %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$landed_weight_kg > 0, !.data$age_allocation_ok) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, .data$Species, .data$GSA_code, .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    unallocated_landed_weight_kg = sum(.data$landed_weight_kg),
    n_catch_rows = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, dplyr::desc(.data$unallocated_landed_weight_kg)
  )

age_profile_catch_provenance <- age_allocation_audit %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    age_profile_source = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$age_profile_source,
      "unresolved"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate, .data$stock_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mapped_landed_weight_kg = sum(.data$landed_weight_kg),
    exact_step1_profile_weight_kg = sum(
      .data$landed_weight_kg[
        .data$age_profile_source == "step1_exact_lpue_cell"
      ]
    ),
    extended_step1_model_weight_kg = sum(
      .data$landed_weight_kg[
        .data$age_profile_source ==
          "step1_age_model_extended_to_step2_catch_support"
      ]
    ),
    commercial_baseline_profile_weight_kg = sum(
      .data$landed_weight_kg[
        .data$age_profile_source ==
          "commercial_catch_baseline_with_step1_depth_model"
      ]
    ),
    unresolved_profile_weight_kg = sum(
      .data$landed_weight_kg[.data$age_profile_source == "unresolved"]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    exact_step1_profile_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$exact_step1_profile_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      1
    ),
    extended_step1_model_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$extended_step1_model_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      0
    ),
    commercial_baseline_profile_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$commercial_baseline_profile_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      0
    ),
    unresolved_profile_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$unresolved_profile_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      0
    ),
    provenance_mass_reconciled = abs(
      .data$exact_step1_profile_weight_kg +
        .data$extended_step1_model_weight_kg +
        .data$commercial_baseline_profile_weight_kg +
        .data$unresolved_profile_weight_kg -
        .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg
    ) <= as.numeric(cfg$catch_mass_tolerance_fraction) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$mapped_landed_weight_kg))
  )

if (any(!age_profile_catch_provenance$provenance_mass_reconciled)) {
  smart31_stop("Age-profile provenance does not reconcile to mapped stock catch mass.")
}

catch_age_allocated <- catch_age_join %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    age_allocation_audit %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$catch_row_id, .data$age_allocation_ok),
    by = "catch_row_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$age_allocation_ok, !is.na(.data$Age)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    landed_weight_at_age_kg = .data$landed_weight_kg *
      .data$age_proportion
  )

stock_run_coverage <- tidyr::crossing(
  eligible_run_status %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(run_keys),
      .data$scenario_year,
      .data$representative_period,
      .data$member_state,
      .data$contract_scenario_code,
      run_converged = converged
    ),
  stock_id = crosswalk_stock_ids
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    age_profile_catch_provenance,
    by = c(run_keys, "stock_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    age_allocation_audit %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate, .data$stock_id
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        failed_age_rows = sum(!.data$age_allocation_ok),
        failed_age_weight_kg = sum(
          .data$landed_weight_kg[!.data$age_allocation_ok]
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c(run_keys, "stock_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mapped_landed_weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg, 0
    ),
    exact_step1_profile_weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$exact_step1_profile_weight_kg, 0
    ),
    extended_step1_model_weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$extended_step1_model_weight_kg, 0
    ),
    commercial_baseline_profile_weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$commercial_baseline_profile_weight_kg, 0
    ),
    unresolved_profile_weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$unresolved_profile_weight_kg, 0
    ),
    exact_step1_profile_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$exact_step1_profile_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      1
    ),
    extended_step1_model_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$extended_step1_model_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      0
    ),
    commercial_baseline_profile_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$commercial_baseline_profile_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      0
    ),
    unresolved_profile_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$unresolved_profile_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      0
    ),
    failed_age_rows = dplyr::coalesce(.data$failed_age_rows, 0L),
    failed_age_weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$failed_age_weight_kg,
      0
    ),
    age_allocation_complete = .data$failed_age_rows == 0L,
    age_allocation_coverage_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      pmax(0, pmin(1,
        1 - .data$failed_age_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg
      )),
      1
    )
  )

catch_at_age_by_gear <- catch_age_allocated %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$scenario_year,
    .data$representative_period, .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$member_state, .data$method, .data$replicate,

catch_at_age_total <- catch_at_age_by_gear %>%
  dplyr::group_by(

    .data$member_state, .data$method, .data$replicate,

  dplyr::summarise(

mapped_stock_catch_mass <- mapped_catches %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate, .data$stock_id) %>%

    mapped_landed_weight_kg = sum(.data$landed_weight_kg),

unallocatable_stock_age_mass <- age_allocation_audit %>%

allocated_stock_age_mass <- catch_at_age_total %>%

  dplyr::summarise(

catch_age_mass_reconciliation <- mapped_stock_catch_mass %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    unallocatable_stock_age_mass,
    by = c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate", "stock_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    allocated_stock_age_mass,
    by = c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate", "stock_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    unallocatable_landed_weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$unallocatable_landed_weight_kg, 0
    ),
    failed_age_rows = dplyr::coalesce(.data$failed_age_rows, 0L),
    allocated_landed_weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$allocated_landed_weight_kg, 0
    ),
    allocatable_mapped_landed_weight_kg = pmax(
      0, .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg - .data$unallocatable_landed_weight_kg
    ),
    difference_kg = .data$allocated_landed_weight_kg -
      .data$allocatable_mapped_landed_weight_kg,
    relative_difference = dplyr::if_else(
      abs(.data$allocatable_mapped_landed_weight_kg) > 0,
      .data$difference_kg / abs(.data$allocatable_mapped_landed_weight_kg),
      0
    ),
    reconciled = abs(.data$difference_kg) <=
      as.numeric(cfg$catch_mass_tolerance_fraction) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$allocatable_mapped_landed_weight_kg)),
    full_spatial_age_coverage = .data$unallocatable_landed_weight_kg <=
      as.numeric(cfg$catch_mass_tolerance_fraction) *
      pmax(1, abs(.data$mapped_landed_weight_kg)),
    spatial_age_coverage_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg > 0,
      .data$allocatable_mapped_landed_weight_kg / .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg,
      1
    )
  )

if (anyNA(catch_age_mass_reconciliation$reconciled) ||
    any(!catch_age_mass_reconciliation$reconciled)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Catch mass with a valid exact or Step 1-model-extended age profile is not ",

}

if (any(!catch_age_mass_reconciliation$full_spatial_age_coverage)) {

if (nrow(missing_catch_age_parameters) > 0L) {
```
