## Baranov functions

```{r step3-08-baranov-functions}

baranov_catch_numbers <- function(F, N, M, interval_years = 1) {
  if (!is.finite(F) || !is.finite(N) || !is.finite(M) ||
      !is.finite(interval_years) || F < 0 || N < 0 || M < 0 ||
      interval_years <= 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  if (F == 0 || N == 0) return(0)
  Z <- F + M
  N * (F / Z) * (-expm1(-Z * interval_years))
}

invert_baranov <- function(
  catch_numbers,
  N,
  M,
  allocation_complete,
  maximum_F,
  root_tolerance,
  zero_catch_fraction,
  reconciliation_tolerance_fraction
) {
  if (!isTRUE(allocation_complete)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_total = NA_real_,
      predicted_catch_numbers = NA_real_,
      absolute_residual_numbers = NA_real_,
      relative_residual = NA_real_,
      baranov_status = "incomplete_spatial_age_allocation"
    ))
  }

  if (!is.finite(catch_numbers) || catch_numbers < 0 ||
      !is.finite(N) || N < 0 || !is.finite(M) || M < 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_total = NA_real_,
      predicted_catch_numbers = NA_real_,
      absolute_residual_numbers = NA_real_,
      relative_residual = NA_real_,
      baranov_status = "invalid_baranov_input"
    ))
  }

  if (catch_numbers <= zero_catch_fraction * max(1, N)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_total = 0,
      predicted_catch_numbers = 0,
      absolute_residual_numbers = catch_numbers,
      relative_residual = if (catch_numbers == 0) 0 else 1,
      baranov_status = "ok_zero_catch"
    ))
  }

  if (N <= 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_total = NA_real_,
      predicted_catch_numbers = NA_real_,
      absolute_residual_numbers = NA_real_,
      relative_residual = NA_real_,
      baranov_status = "positive_catch_with_zero_abundance"
    ))
  }

  if (catch_numbers >= N) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_total = NA_real_,
      predicted_catch_numbers = NA_real_,
      absolute_residual_numbers = NA_real_,
      relative_residual = NA_real_,
      baranov_status = "dead_removals_not_below_starting_abundance"
    ))
  }

  objective <- function(F) {
    baranov_catch_numbers(F, N, M) - catch_numbers
  }

  upper <- min(1, maximum_F)
  while (upper < maximum_F && objective(upper) < 0) {
    upper <- min(maximum_F, upper * 2)
  }

  if (objective(upper) < 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_total = NA_real_,
      predicted_catch_numbers = baranov_catch_numbers(upper, N, M),
      absolute_residual_numbers = abs(objective(upper)),
      relative_residual = abs(objective(upper)) / max(1, catch_numbers),
      baranov_status = "solution_exceeds_maximum_F"
    ))
  }

  solution <- tryCatch(
    stats::uniroot(
      objective,
      interval = c(0, upper),
      tol = root_tolerance,
      maxiter = 1000L
    )$root,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  if (!is.finite(solution)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      F_total = NA_real_,
      predicted_catch_numbers = NA_real_,
      absolute_residual_numbers = NA_real_,
      relative_residual = NA_real_,
      baranov_status = "root_finding_failed"
    ))
  }

  predicted <- baranov_catch_numbers(solution, N, M)
  residual <- abs(predicted - catch_numbers)
  relative_residual <- residual / max(1, catch_numbers)

  tibble::tibble(
    F_total = solution,
    predicted_catch_numbers = predicted,
    absolute_residual_numbers = residual,
    relative_residual = relative_residual,
    baranov_status = if (
      is.finite(relative_residual) &&
      relative_residual <= reconciliation_tolerance_fraction
    ) {
      "ok"
    } else {
      "residual_above_tolerance"
    }
  )
}
```

## Estimate F at age

```{r step3-09-estimate-f-at-age}

run_period_keys <- eligible_run_status %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(run_keys),
    .data$scenario_year,
    .data$representative_period,
    .data$member_state,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    run_converged = converged
  )

f_input_grid <- run_period_keys %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    stock_age_parameters,
    by = "representative_period",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$stock_id %in% crosswalk_stock_ids) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_reference_points %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$stock_id, .data$stock_label),
    by = "stock_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    catch_at_age_total %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(run_keys),
        .data$stock_id,
        .data$Age,
        .data$landed_weight_at_age_kg
      ),
    by = c(run_keys, "stock_id", "Age"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_run_coverage %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(run_keys),
        .data$stock_id,
        .data$age_allocation_complete,
        .data$failed_age_rows,
        .data$failed_age_weight_kg
      ),
    by = c(run_keys, "stock_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    landed_weight_at_age_kg = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$landed_weight_at_age_kg,
      0
    ),
    age_allocation_complete = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$age_allocation_complete,
      TRUE
    ),
    dead_removal_weight_at_age_kg = .data$landed_weight_at_age_kg *
      .data$landings_to_dead_removals_multiplier,
    dead_removal_numbers = .data$dead_removal_weight_at_age_kg /
      .data$mean_weight_kg
  )

baranov_results <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(
    catch_numbers = f_input_grid$dead_removal_numbers,
    N = f_input_grid$N_start,
    M = f_input_grid$M,
    allocation_complete = f_input_grid$age_allocation_complete
  ),
  function(catch_numbers, N, M, allocation_complete) {
    invert_baranov(
      catch_numbers,
      N,
      M,
      allocation_complete,
      maximum_F = as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F),
      root_tolerance = as.numeric(cfg$baranov_root_tolerance),
      zero_catch_fraction = as.numeric(cfg$baranov_zero_catch_fraction),
      reconciliation_tolerance_fraction =
        as.numeric(cfg$baranov_reconciliation_tolerance_fraction)
    )
  }
)

f_at_age <- dplyr::bind_cols(f_input_grid, baranov_results) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    representative_year_start = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$baseline,
      .smart31_years$baseline,
      .smart31_years$future_start
    ),
    representative_year_end = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$baseline,
      .smart31_years$baseline,
      .smart31_years$future_end
    ),
    dead_removal_fraction_of_N = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$N_start > 0,
      .data$dead_removal_numbers / .data$N_start,
      dplyr::if_else(.data$dead_removal_numbers == 0, 0, Inf)
    ),
    high_F_flag = is.finite(.data$F_total) &
      .data$F_total > as.numeric(cfg$high_F_warning_threshold),
    high_dead_removal_fraction_flag = is.finite(.data$dead_removal_fraction_of_N) &
      .data$dead_removal_fraction_of_N >
        as.numeric(cfg$dead_removal_fraction_warning_threshold),
    baranov_reconciled = .data$baranov_status %in% c("ok", "ok_zero_catch") &
      is.finite(.data$relative_residual) &
      (.data$baranov_status == "ok_zero_catch" |
       .data$relative_residual <= as.numeric(cfg$baranov_reconciliation_tolerance_fraction)),
    F_units = "annual_instantaneous_rate",
    temporal_semantics = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$baseline,
      "annual_representative_vector_for_2026",
      "one_annual_representative_vector_reused_for_2027_2030"
    ),
    F_interpretation =
      "raw_ITA_pressure_proxy_from_direct_Baranov_inversion_not_total_assessment_F"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, .data$Age
  )

baranov_status_summary <- f_at_age %>%
  dplyr::count(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$baranov_status,
    name = "n_stock_age_rows"
  )

baranov_reconciliation_audit <- f_at_age %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, .data$stock_label, .data$Age,
    .data$N_start, .data$M, .data$mean_weight_kg,
    .data$dead_removal_numbers,
    .data$dead_removal_fraction_of_N,
    .data$F_total, .data$predicted_catch_numbers,
    .data$absolute_residual_numbers, .data$relative_residual,
    .data$baranov_status, .data$baranov_reconciled,
    .data$high_F_flag, .data$high_dead_removal_fraction_flag
  )

terminal_age_lookup <- stock_age_parameters %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$stock_id, .data$representative_period) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(terminal_age = max(.data$Age), .groups = "drop")

baranov_failure_audit <- f_at_age %>%
  dplyr::filter(!.data$baranov_status %in% c("ok", "ok_zero_catch")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    terminal_age_lookup,
    by = c("stock_id", "representative_period"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_terminal_age = .data$Age == .data$terminal_age,
    abundance_shortfall_numbers = pmax(
      .data$dead_removal_numbers - .data$N_start,
      0
    ),
    abundance_shortfall_kg =
      .data$abundance_shortfall_numbers * .data$mean_weight_kg,
    maximum_catch_fraction_at_maximum_F =
      as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F) /
      (as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F) + .data$M) *
      (-expm1(-(as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F) + .data$M))),
    minimum_N_required_at_maximum_F = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$dead_removal_numbers > 0 &
        is.finite(.data$maximum_catch_fraction_at_maximum_F) &
        .data$maximum_catch_fraction_at_maximum_F > 0,
      .data$dead_removal_numbers / .data$maximum_catch_fraction_at_maximum_F,
      NA_real_
    ),
    minimum_N_multiplier_at_maximum_F = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$N_start > 0 & is.finite(.data$minimum_N_required_at_maximum_F),
      .data$minimum_N_required_at_maximum_F / .data$N_start,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, .data$stock_label, .data$representative_period,
    .data$Age, .data$terminal_age, .data$is_terminal_age,
    .data$N_start, .data$M, .data$mean_weight_kg,
    .data$dead_removal_numbers, .data$dead_removal_fraction_of_N,
    .data$abundance_shortfall_numbers, .data$abundance_shortfall_kg,
    .data$minimum_N_required_at_maximum_F,
    .data$minimum_N_multiplier_at_maximum_F,
    .data$F_total, .data$predicted_catch_numbers,
    .data$absolute_residual_numbers, .data$relative_residual,
    .data$baranov_status, .data$baranov_reconciled
  )

smart31_kable(
  baranov_status_summary,
  caption = "Baranov inversion status"
)

if (nrow(baranov_failure_audit) > 0L) {
  smart31_kable(
    baranov_failure_audit,
    digits = 6,
    caption = paste(
      "Positive-catch Baranov failures after high-precision root solving;",
      "diagnostic only — no abundance or catch is modified"
    )
  )
}
```

## Partial F by gear

```{r step3-10-partial-f-by-gear}

f_partial_by_gear <- catch_at_age_by_gear %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_age_parameters %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$stock_id, .data$representative_period, .data$Age,
        .data$mean_weight_kg,
        .data$landings_to_dead_removals_multiplier
      ),
    by = c("stock_id", "representative_period", "Age"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dead_removal_numbers_gear =
      .data$landed_weight_at_age_kg *
      .data$landings_to_dead_removals_multiplier /
      .data$mean_weight_kg
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, .data$Age
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_dead_removal_numbers = sum(.data$dead_removal_numbers_gear),
    dead_removal_share = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$total_dead_removal_numbers > 0,
      .data$dead_removal_numbers_gear /
        .data$total_dead_removal_numbers,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    f_at_age %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(run_keys),
        .data$stock_id, .data$Age,
        .data$F_total, .data$baranov_status
      ),
    by = c(run_keys, "stock_id", "Age"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    F_partial = .data$F_total * .data$dead_removal_share
  )

partial_f_reconciliation <- f_partial_by_gear %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, .data$Age
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    F_total = one_value(.data$F_total, "total fishing mortality"),
    sum_partial_F = sum(.data$F_partial),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    absolute_error = abs(.data$F_total - .data$sum_partial_F),
    reconciled = is.na(.data$F_total) |
      .data$absolute_error <= as.numeric(cfg$partial_f_tolerance_fraction) * pmax(1, abs(.data$F_total))
  )

if (anyNA(partial_f_reconciliation$reconciled) ||
    any(!partial_f_reconciliation$reconciled)) {
  smart31_stop("Gear-specific fishing mortality does not reconcile to total F.")
}
```

## Stock F indicators

```{r step3-11-stock-f-indicators}

stock_f_indicators <- f_at_age %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_reference_points %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$stock_id, .data$Fbar_age_min,
        .data$Fbar_age_max, .data$Fmsy
      ),
    by = "stock_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Fbar_reference_available = !is.na(.data$Fbar_age_min) &
      !is.na(.data$Fbar_age_max),
    Fmsy_reference_available = is.finite(.data$Fmsy) & .data$Fmsy > 0,
    in_Fbar_age_range = .data$Fbar_reference_available &
      .data$Age >= .data$Fbar_age_min &
      .data$Age <= .data$Fbar_age_max,
    F_available = .data$baranov_status %in% c("ok", "ok_zero_catch") &
      is.finite(.data$F_total)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$scenario_year,
    .data$representative_period, .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$member_state, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$run_converged, .data$stock_id, .data$stock_label,
    .data$Fbar_age_min, .data$Fbar_age_max, .data$Fmsy,
    .data$Fbar_reference_available, .data$Fmsy_reference_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_Fbar_ages_expected = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$Fbar_reference_available[[1L]],
      as.integer(.data$Fbar_age_max[[1L]] - .data$Fbar_age_min[[1L]] + 1L),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    n_Fbar_ages_available = sum(
      .data$in_Fbar_age_range & .data$F_available
    ),
    Fbar_candidate = if (.data$Fbar_reference_available[[1L]] &&
                         any(.data$in_Fbar_age_range & .data$F_available)) {
      mean(.data$F_total[.data$in_Fbar_age_range & .data$F_available])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Fbar = dplyr::case_when(
      !.data$Fbar_reference_available ~ NA_real_,
      .data$n_Fbar_ages_available == .data$n_Fbar_ages_expected ~
        .data$Fbar_candidate,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    F_over_Fmsy = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$Fmsy_reference_available & is.finite(.data$Fbar),
      .data$Fbar / .data$Fmsy,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Fbar_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !.data$Fbar_reference_available ~ "reference_age_range_missing",
      .data$n_Fbar_ages_available == .data$n_Fbar_ages_expected ~ "complete",
      TRUE ~ "incomplete_age_range"
    ),
    Fmsy_status = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$Fmsy_reference_available,
      "available",
      "reference_Fmsy_missing"
    )
  )

stock_catches_by_run <- stock_run_coverage %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_attributes,
    by = "stock_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$scenario_id, .data$scenario_year,
    .data$representative_period, .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$member_state, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$stock_id, .data$stock_label, .data$target_stock,
    catch_t = .data$mapped_landed_weight_kg / 1000
  )
```

## FDI harmonised anchor

```{r step3-12-fdi-harmonised-2025-anchor}

required_step1_calibration_objects <- c(
  "landings_list", "species_to_submit", "gears_to_submit", "CS_gsas"
)
missing_step1_calibration_objects <- setdiff(
  required_step1_calibration_objects,
  names(step1_inputs)
)
if (length(missing_step1_calibration_objects) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Step 1 bundle is missing calibration objects required by : ",
    paste(missing_step1_calibration_objects, collapse = ", "), "."
  )
}

selected_species_calibration <- normalise_code(step1_inputs$species_to_submit)
selected_gears_calibration <- normalise_code(step1_inputs$gears_to_submit)
selected_gsas_calibration <- normalise_gsa_parent(step1_inputs$CS_gsas)
selected_vessel_lengths_calibration <- c(
  "VL1218", "VL1824", "VL2440", "VL40XX"
)

fdi_table_a_path <- normalizePath(
  path.expand(cfg$fdi_table_a_2024_2025_file),
  mustWork = TRUE
)
fdi_table_a_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(fdi_table_a_path))
expected_fdi_md5 <- as.character(
  cfg$expected_fdi_table_a_md5 %||% NA_character_
)

if (length(expected_fdi_md5) == 1L &&
    !is.na(expected_fdi_md5) &&
    nzchar(expected_fdi_md5) &&
    !identical(fdi_table_a_md5, expected_fdi_md5)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "FDI Table A does not match the controlled reference. ",
    "Expected MD5: ", expected_fdi_md5,
    "; observed MD5: ", fdi_table_a_md5, "."
  )
}

fdi_raw <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(
  fdi_table_a_path,
  detectDates = FALSE
) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

names(fdi_raw) <- trimws(names(fdi_raw))

fdi_year_col <- pick_column(
  fdi_raw, c("YEAR", "year", "Year"),
  label = "FDI year column"
)
fdi_species_col <- pick_column(
  fdi_raw, c("SPECIES", "species", "Species"),
  label = "FDI species column"
)
fdi_gsa_col <- pick_column(
  fdi_raw, c("SUB_REGION", "sub_region", "Sub_region"),
  label = "FDI sub-region column"
)
fdi_gear_col <- pick_column(
  fdi_raw, c("GEAR_TYPE", "gear_type", "Gear"),
  label = "FDI gear column"
)
fdi_vl_col <- pick_column(
  fdi_raw, c("VESSEL_LENGTH", "vessel_length", "VL"),
  label = "FDI vessel-length column"
)
fdi_weight_col <- pick_column(
  fdi_raw,
  c("TOTWGHTLANDG", "totwghtlandg", "LANDINGS", "landings"),
  label = "FDI landed-weight column"
)
fdi_country_col <- pick_column(
  fdi_raw,
  c("COUNTRY", "country", "COUNTRY_CODE", "country_code"),
  required = FALSE,
  label = "FDI country column"
)
fdi_supra_col <- pick_column(
  fdi_raw,
  c("SUPRA_REGION", "supra_region"),
  required = FALSE,
  label = "FDI supra-region column"
)

fdi_prepared <- fdi_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(.data[[fdi_year_col]]))),
    Species = normalise_code(.data[[fdi_species_col]]),
    GSA_code = normalise_gsa_parent(.data[[fdi_gsa_col]]),
    Gear = normalise_code(.data[[fdi_gear_col]]),
    VESSEL_LENGTH = normalise_code(.data[[fdi_vl_col]]),
    FDI_landings_t = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[fdi_weight_col]])),
    COUNTRY = if (!is.null(fdi_country_col)) {
      normalise_code(.data[[fdi_country_col]])
    } else {
      "ITA_SOURCE_FILE"
    },
    SUPRA_REGION = if (!is.null(fdi_supra_col)) {
      normalise_code(.data[[fdi_supra_col]])
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR %in% c(
      as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max),
      as.integer(cfg$calibration_anchor_year)
    ),
    .data$Species %in% selected_species_calibration,
    .data$GSA_code %in% selected_gsas_calibration,
    .data$Gear %in% selected_gears_calibration,
    .data$VESSEL_LENGTH %in% selected_vessel_lengths_calibration,
    is.finite(.data$FDI_landings_t),
    .data$FDI_landings_t >= 0
  )

if (!is.null(fdi_country_col)) {
  fdi_prepared <- fdi_prepared %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$COUNTRY == .smart31_case$domain$country)
}
if (!is.null(fdi_supra_col)) {
  fdi_prepared <- fdi_prepared %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$SUPRA_REGION == "MBS")
}

fdi_year_check <- fdi_prepared %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$YEAR) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    FDI_landings_t = sum(.data$FDI_landings_t),
    n_species = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Species),
    n_gears = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$Gear),
    n_gsas = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$GSA_code),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

required_fdi_years <- c(
  as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max),
  as.integer(cfg$calibration_anchor_year)
)
if (!all(required_fdi_years %in% fdi_year_check$YEAR)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "FDI Table A does not contain both controlled calibration years ",
    paste(required_fdi_years, collapse = " and "),
    " after SMART-scope filtering."
  )
}

landings_flat <- dplyr::bind_rows(step1_inputs$landings_list)
assert_columns(
  landings_flat,
  c("Year", "Month", "CFR", "Gear", "Species", "GSA_LB", "Kg"),
  "Step 1 landings_list"
)

landings_prepared <- landings_flat %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data$Year)),
    MONTH = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data$Month)),
    CFR = trimws(as.character(.data$CFR)),
    Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear),
    Species = normalise_code(.data$Species),
    GSA_code = normalise_gsa_parent(.data$GSA_LB),
    SMART_landings_kg = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$Kg))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR >= min(assessment_catch_history$Year),
    .data$YEAR <= as.integer(cfg$calibration_anchor_year),
    .data$Species %in% selected_species_calibration,
    .data$Gear %in% selected_gears_calibration,
    .data$GSA_code %in% selected_gsas_calibration,
    is.finite(.data$SMART_landings_kg),
    .data$SMART_landings_kg >= 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    assessment_stock_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$Species, .data$GSA_code,
        .data$assessment_stock, .data$assessment_label
      ),
    by = c("Species", "GSA_code"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

if (!as.integer(cfg$calibration_anchor_year) %in% landings_prepared$YEAR) {
  smart31_stop(
    smart31_report_label("Frozen Step 1 landings_list does not contain the controlled 2025 anchor year.")
  )
}

fdi_strata <- fdi_prepared %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    FDI_landings_kg = sum(.data$FDI_landings_t) * 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

smart_strata <- landings_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR %in% required_fdi_years
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    SMART_landings_kg = sum(.data$SMART_landings_kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fdi_stratum_comparison <- dplyr::full_join(
  smart_strata,
  fdi_strata,
  by = c("YEAR", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(.data$SMART_landings_kg) &
        !is.na(.data$FDI_landings_kg) ~ "matched",
      !is.na(.data$SMART_landings_kg) &
        is.na(.data$FDI_landings_kg) ~ "logbook_only",
      is.na(.data$SMART_landings_kg) &
        !is.na(.data$FDI_landings_kg) ~ "FDI_only",
      TRUE ~ "unclassified"
    ),
    calibration_factor = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$source_status == "matched" &
        .data$SMART_landings_kg > 0 ~
        .data$FDI_landings_kg / .data$SMART_landings_kg,
      .data$source_status == "logbook_only" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    assessment_stock_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$Species, .data$GSA_code,
        .data$assessment_stock, .data$assessment_label
      ),
    by = c("Species", "GSA_code"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

fdi_stratum_audit <- fdi_stratum_comparison %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label,
    .data$YEAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_matched = sum(.data$source_status == "matched"),
    n_logbook_only = sum(.data$source_status == "logbook_only"),
    n_FDI_only = sum(.data$source_status == "FDI_only"),
    SMART_landings_t =
      sum(.data$SMART_landings_kg, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    FDI_landings_t =
      sum(.data$FDI_landings_kg, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    FDI_only_t =
      sum(
        .data$FDI_landings_kg[
          .data$source_status == "FDI_only"
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

validation_2024 <- fdi_stratum_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR == as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    expected_post_calibration_kg = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$source_status == "matched" ~ .data$FDI_landings_kg,
      .data$source_status == "logbook_only" ~ .data$SMART_landings_kg,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    difference_kg =
      .data$SMART_landings_kg - .data$expected_post_calibration_kg
  )

validation_2024_summary <- validation_2024 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$source_status %in% c("matched", "logbook_only")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_tested_strata = dplyr::n(),
    maximum_absolute_difference_kg =
      safe_max(abs(.data$difference_kg)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    calibration_rule_reproduces_2024 =
      is.finite(.data$maximum_absolute_difference_kg) &
      .data$maximum_absolute_difference_kg <= 1e-6
  )

if (!isTRUE(validation_2024_summary$calibration_rule_reproduces_2024)) {
  print(validation_2024)
  smart31_stop(
    smart31_report_label("The reconstructed FDI calibration rule does not reproduce frozen Step 1 2024.")
  )
}

calibration_2025 <- fdi_stratum_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR == as.integer(cfg$calibration_anchor_year),
    .data$source_status %in% c("matched", "logbook_only")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear,
    .data$source_status,
    SMART_stratum_landings_kg = SMART_landings_kg,
    FDI_stratum_landings_kg = FDI_landings_kg,
    .data$calibration_factor
  )

if (nrow(calibration_2025) == 0L ||
    any(!is.finite(calibration_2025$calibration_factor)) ||
    any(calibration_2025$calibration_factor <= 0)) {
  smart31_stop(smart31_report_label("Invalid 2025 FDI calibration factors."))
}

landings_2025_corrected <- landings_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR == as.integer(cfg$calibration_anchor_year)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    calibration_2025,
    by = c("YEAR", "GSA_code", "Species", "Gear"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

if (anyNA(landings_2025_corrected$calibration_factor)) {
  smart31_stop(
    smart31_report_label("At least one frozen 2025 SMART landing record has no matched/logbook-only FDI calibration rule.")
  )
}

landings_2025_corrected <- landings_2025_corrected %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDI_harmonised_landings_kg =
      .data$SMART_landings_kg * .data$calibration_factor
  )

corrected_2025_strata_check <- landings_2025_corrected %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR, .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear,
    .data$source_status, .data$FDI_stratum_landings_kg
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    raw_SMART_kg = sum(.data$SMART_landings_kg),
    corrected_SMART_kg = sum(.data$FDI_harmonised_landings_kg),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    expected_corrected_kg = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$source_status == "matched" ~ .data$FDI_stratum_landings_kg,
      .data$source_status == "logbook_only" ~ .data$raw_SMART_kg,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    difference_kg =
      .data$corrected_SMART_kg - .data$expected_corrected_kg,
    reconciled =
      is.finite(.data$difference_kg) &
      abs(.data$difference_kg) <= 1e-6
  )

if (!all(corrected_2025_strata_check$reconciled)) {
  print(corrected_2025_strata_check)
  smart31_stop(
    smart31_report_label("Post-hoc 2025 FDI harmonisation failed stratum-level reconciliation.")
  )
}

controlled_anchor_2025 <- landings_2025_corrected %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    raw_step1_landings_t =
      sum(.data$SMART_landings_kg) / 1000,
    fdi_harmonised_landings_t =
      sum(.data$FDI_harmonised_landings_kg) / 1000,
    n_records = dplyr::n(),
    n_vessels = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR),
    n_months = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$MONTH),
    n_matched_strata = dplyr::n_distinct(
      paste(
        .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear,
        sep = "::"
      )[.data$source_status == "matched"]
    ),
    n_logbook_only_strata = dplyr::n_distinct(
      paste(
        .data$GSA_code, .data$Species, .data$Gear,
        sep = "::"
      )[.data$source_status == "logbook_only"]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    fdi_stratum_audit %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$YEAR == as.integer(cfg$calibration_anchor_year)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        fdi_total_in_smart_scope_t = FDI_landings_t,
        fdi_only_t = FDI_only_t,
        n_fdi_only_strata = n_FDI_only
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fdi_matched_coverage_fraction = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$fdi_total_in_smart_scope_t > 0,
      (.data$fdi_total_in_smart_scope_t - .data$fdi_only_t) /
        .data$fdi_total_in_smart_scope_t,
      NA_real_
    ),
    fdi_source_file = basename(fdi_table_a_path),
    fdi_source_md5 = fdi_table_a_md5,
    step1_bundle_file = basename(step1_bundle_file),
    step1_bundle_md5 = configured_step1_md5,
    calibration_method = paste(
      "post-hoc replication of frozen Step1 FDI rule at",
      "YEAR x GSA x Species x Gear;",
      "matched=FDI/logbook; logbook-only=1; FDI-only not invented"
    )
  )

if (nrow(controlled_anchor_2025) != length(expected_assessment_stocks) ||
    any(controlled_anchor_2025$n_fdi_only_strata != 0L) ||
    any(controlled_anchor_2025$n_logbook_only_strata != 0L) ||
    any(abs(controlled_anchor_2025$fdi_matched_coverage_fraction - 1) >
        1e-12)) {
  print(controlled_anchor_2025)
  smart31_stop(
    smart31_report_label("The target assessment stocks do not have complete matched FDI support in 2025.")
  )
}

smart31_kable(
  controlled_anchor_2025,
  digits = 6,
  caption = smart31_report_label("Controlled FDI-harmonised Italian landing anchor for 2025")
)
```

## Assessment landing share calibration

```{r step3-13-assessment-landing-share-calibration}

historical_ita_landings <- landings_prepared %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$YEAR >= min(assessment_catch_history$Year),
    .data$YEAR <= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label,
    .data$YEAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    SMART_ITA_landings_t =
      sum(.data$SMART_landings_kg) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

historical_landing_share <- assessment_catch_history %>%
  dplyr::rename(YEAR = Year) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    historical_ita_landings,
    by = c("assessment_stock", "assessment_label", "YEAR"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    q_ITA_landings =
      .data$SMART_ITA_landings_t / .data$assessment_landings_t,
    q_out_of_bounds =
      !is.finite(.data$q_ITA_landings) |
      .data$q_ITA_landings < 0 |
      .data$q_ITA_landings > 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$assessment_stock, .data$YEAR)

if (anyNA(historical_landing_share$SMART_ITA_landings_t)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Historical SMART Italian landings are missing for an assessment stock-year."
  )
}

share_calibration <- historical_landing_share %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_calibration_years = sum(
      .data$YEAR >= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_min) &
      .data$YEAR <= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max) &
      is.finite(.data$q_ITA_landings)
    ),
    q_ref = median_or_na(
      .data$q_ITA_landings[
        .data$YEAR >= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_min) &
        .data$YEAR <= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max)
      ]
    ),
    q_2024 = one_value(
      .data$q_ITA_landings[
        .data$YEAR == as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max)
      ],
      "terminal historical Italian landing share"
    ),
    q_min = safe_min(
      .data$q_ITA_landings[
        .data$YEAR >= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_min) &
        .data$YEAR <= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max)
      ]
    ),
    q_max = safe_max(
      .data$q_ITA_landings[
        .data$YEAR >= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_min) &
        .data$YEAR <= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max)
      ]
    ),
    n_out_of_bounds_2020_2024 =
      sum(.data$q_out_of_bounds, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    q_ref_valid =
      .data$n_calibration_years ==
        as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max) -
        as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_min) + 1L &
      is.finite(.data$q_ref) &
      .data$q_ref > 0 &
      .data$q_ref <= 1,
    q_2024_valid =
      is.finite(.data$q_2024) &
      .data$q_2024 > 0 &
      .data$q_2024 <= 1
  )

if (any(!share_calibration$q_ref_valid)) {
  print(share_calibration)
  smart31_stop(
    smart31_report_label("Median 2022-2024 Italian landing share is invalid for at least one assessment stock.")
  )
}

smart31_kable(
  share_calibration,
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Assessment-stock Italian landing-share calibration"
)

independent_calibration_reference <- read.csv(
 cfg$calibration_expected_file, stringsAsFactors=FALSE) %>% tibble::as_tibble()

calibration_regression_audit <- independent_calibration_reference %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    controlled_anchor_2025 %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        observed_anchor_2025_t =
          .data$fdi_harmonised_landings_t
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    share_calibration %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        observed_q_ref = q_ref
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    anchor_difference_t =
      .data$observed_anchor_2025_t -
      .data$expected_anchor_2025_t,
    q_difference =
      .data$observed_q_ref -
      .data$expected_q_ref,
    regression_match =
      abs(.data$anchor_difference_t) <= 1e-6 &
      abs(.data$q_difference) <= 5e-6
  )

if (anyNA(calibration_regression_audit$regression_match) ||
    any(!calibration_regression_audit$regression_match)) {
  print(calibration_regression_audit)
  smart31_stop(
    "Calibration does not reproduce the supplied independent anchor/share diagnostic."
  )
}

smart31_kable(
  calibration_regression_audit,
  digits = 8,
  caption =
    "Regression check against the locally verified independent calibration diagnostic"
)
```

## Assessment F anchor

```{r step3-14-assessment-f-anchor-2025}

recent_selectivity <- assessment_history %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$Year >= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_min),
    .data$Year <= as.integer(cfg$calibration_year_max)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    selectivity_relative_to_Fbar =
      .data$F_total_assessment / .data$Fbar_assessment_reported
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label,
    .data$Age
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_recent_selectivity =
      mean(.data$selectivity_relative_to_Fbar),
    M_reference_2025 = mean(.data$M),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    assessment_reference_points %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$Fbar_age_min,
        .data$Fbar_age_max,
        Fbar_2025 = Fbar_assessment_anchor,
        .data$Fmsy,
        .data$SSB_2025_t
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$assessment_stock) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    selectivity_normalizer = mean(
      .data$mean_recent_selectivity[
        .data$Age >= .data$Fbar_age_min &
        .data$Age <= .data$Fbar_age_max
      ]
    ),
    selectivity_2025 =
      .data$mean_recent_selectivity / .data$selectivity_normalizer,
    F_total_anchor_2025 =
      .data$Fbar_2025 * .data$selectivity_2025
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    share_calibration %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$q_ref,
        .data$q_2024,
        .data$q_ref_valid,
        .data$q_2024_valid
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    controlled_anchor_2025 %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$raw_step1_landings_t,
        .data$fdi_harmonised_landings_t
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

anchor_age_main <- recent_selectivity %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    calibration = .smart31_case$calibration_id,
    q_used = .data$q_ref,
    q_used_valid = .data$q_ref_valid,
    F_ITA_anchor_2025 =
      .data$q_used * .data$F_total_anchor_2025,
    F_external_anchor_2025 =
      .data$F_total_anchor_2025 - .data$F_ITA_anchor_2025
  )

anchor_age_sensitivity <- recent_selectivity %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    calibration = .smart31_case$sensitivity_id,
    q_used = .data$q_2024,
    q_used_valid = .data$q_2024_valid,
    F_ITA_anchor_2025 = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$q_used_valid,
      .data$q_used * .data$F_total_anchor_2025,
      NA_real_
    ),
    F_external_anchor_2025 = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$q_used_valid,
      .data$F_total_anchor_2025 - .data$F_ITA_anchor_2025,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

anchor_age_state <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  anchor_age_main,
  anchor_age_sensitivity
)

anchor_fbar_audit <- anchor_age_state %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$Age >= .data$Fbar_age_min,
    .data$Age <= .data$Fbar_age_max
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$calibration,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    supplied_Fbar_2025 = one_value(.data$Fbar_2025, smart31_report_label("2025 Fbar anchor")),
    reconstructed_Fbar_2025 = mean(.data$F_total_anchor_2025),
    absolute_difference =
      .data$reconstructed_Fbar_2025 - .data$supplied_Fbar_2025,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(
  abs(anchor_fbar_audit$absolute_difference) >
    as.numeric(cfg$calibration_root_tolerance) * 100
)) {
  print(anchor_fbar_audit)
  smart31_stop(smart31_report_label("2025 assessment F-at-age anchor does not reconcile to official Fbar."))
}

continuity_test <- anchor_age_state %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(function(...) {
    row <- list(...)
    solved <- solve_relative_partial_f(
      ratio = 1,
      F_ITA_anchor = row$F_ITA_anchor_2025,
      M = row$M_reference_2025,
      F_external = row$F_external_anchor_2025,
      maximum_partial_F = as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F),
      tolerance = as.numeric(cfg$calibration_root_tolerance)
    )
    dplyr::bind_cols(tibble::as_tibble(row), solved)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    F_total_ratio_1 =
      .data$F_external_anchor_2025 + .data$F_ITA_future,
    continuity_difference =
      .data$F_total_ratio_1 - .data$F_total_anchor_2025
  )

continuity_summary <- continuity_test %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$calibration,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    all_ages_solved =
      all(.data$calibration_status == "ok"),
    maximum_absolute_difference =
      safe_max(abs(.data$continuity_difference)),
    continuity_pass =
      .data$all_ages_solved &
      .data$maximum_absolute_difference <= 1e-8,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(
  continuity_summary$calibration ==
    .smart31_case$calibration_id &
  !continuity_summary$continuity_pass
)) {
  print(continuity_summary)
  smart31_stop(
    "The relative-F ratio=1 continuity identity failed."
  )
}
```

## Export calibrated FMSY limits for Step 2

```{r step3-15-export-fmsy-limits-for-step2}

stopifnot(all(c("assessment_stock", "Species") %in% names(assessment_stock_crosswalk)))
fmsy_stock_species <- assessment_stock_crosswalk %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$assessment_stock, .data$Species)
if (anyDuplicated(fmsy_stock_species$assessment_stock)) {
  smart31_stop("FMSY constraint requires a one-to-one assessment stock / Species mapping in Step 2. Extend the Step 2 catch index by GSA before using this export.")
}
fmsy_main_age <- anchor_age_state %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$calibration == .smart31_case$calibration_id,
                .data$Age >= .data$Fbar_age_min,
                .data$Age <= .data$Fbar_age_max)
if (any(!is.finite(fmsy_main_age$Fmsy)) ||
    any(fmsy_main_age$Fmsy <= 0) ||
    any(!is.finite(fmsy_main_age$F_ITA_anchor_2025)) ||
    any(!is.finite(fmsy_main_age$F_external_anchor_2025))) {
  smart31_stop(smart31_report_label("Incomplete age-specific 2025 assessment anchor for FMSY constraints."))
}
fmsy_max_partial <- as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F)
fmsy_tolerance <- as.numeric(cfg$calibration_root_tolerance)
fmsy_limits_export <- purrr::map_dfr(split(fmsy_main_age, fmsy_main_age$assessment_stock), function(ages) {
  stock <- ages$assessment_stock[[1L]]
  if (any(ages$F_ITA_anchor_2025 <= 0))
    smart31_stop("Zero Italian partial F cannot be inverted for ", stock, ".")
  if (length(unique(ages$Fmsy)) != 1L)
    smart31_stop("Multiple Fmsy values for ", stock, ".")
  evaluate_ratio <- function(ratio) {
    solved <- purrr::pmap_dfr(list(ratio = rep(ratio, nrow(ages)),
      F_ITA_anchor = ages$F_ITA_anchor_2025,
      M = ages$M_reference_2025,
      F_external = ages$F_external_anchor_2025),
      function(ratio, F_ITA_anchor, M, F_external)
        solve_relative_partial_f(ratio, F_ITA_anchor, M, F_external,
          maximum_partial_F = fmsy_max_partial, tolerance = fmsy_tolerance))
    if (any(!solved$calibration_status %in% c("ok", "ok_zero_ratio")))
      smart31_stop("Cannot reproduce Step 3 calibrated F for ", stock,
        " at landing ratio ", signif(ratio, 8), ".")
    mean(ages$F_external_anchor_2025 + solved$F_ITA_future)
  }
  floor_f <- mean(ages$F_external_anchor_2025)
  target <- ages$Fmsy[[1L]]
  if (floor_f >= target - 1e-10)
    smart31_stop("FMSY is unreachable for ", stock,
      ": mean F from non-Italian fleets >= Fmsy.")
  anchor_g <- mapply(g_partial, ages$F_ITA_anchor_2025,
    ages$M_reference_2025, ages$F_external_anchor_2025)
  upper_g <- mapply(g_partial, rep(fmsy_max_partial, nrow(ages)),
    ages$M_reference_2025, ages$F_external_anchor_2025)
  ratio_hi <- min(upper_g / anchor_g) * (1 - 1e-7)
  if (!is.finite(ratio_hi) || ratio_hi <= 0 || evaluate_ratio(ratio_hi) < target)
    smart31_stop("FMSY inverse is not bracketed within maximum_F for ", stock, ".")
  ratio_limit <- stats::uniroot(function(r) evaluate_ratio(r) - target,
    c(0, ratio_hi), tol = max(fmsy_tolerance / 100, 1e-9))$root * (1 - 1e-6)
  if (evaluate_ratio(ratio_limit) > target + fmsy_tolerance)
    smart31_stop("Exported FMSY bound exceeds target for ", stock, ".")
  anchor_t <- controlled_anchor_2025$fdi_harmonised_landings_t[
    controlled_anchor_2025$assessment_stock == stock]
  if (length(anchor_t) != 1L || !is.finite(anchor_t) || anchor_t <= 0)
    smart31_stop(smart31_report_label("No unique positive FDI-harmonised 2025 landing anchor for "), stock, ".")
  tibble::tibble(assessment_stock = stock,
    Species = fmsy_stock_species$Species[match(stock, fmsy_stock_species$assessment_stock)],
    YEAR = .smart31_years$future, quota_kg = 1000 * anchor_t * ratio_limit,
    Fmsy = target, F_external_floor = floor_f,
    anchor_2025_t = anchor_t, maximum_future_to_anchor_ratio = ratio_limit,
    age_F_ITA_anchor = paste(format(ages$F_ITA_anchor_2025, digits = 17), collapse = ";"),
    age_M_reference = paste(format(ages$M_reference_2025, digits = 17), collapse = ";"),
    age_F_external = paste(format(ages$F_external_anchor_2025, digits = 17), collapse = ";"),
    calibration = .smart31_case$calibration_id,
    source = smart31_report_label("Step3 assessment-scale FDI 2025 inverse"))
})
if (nrow(fmsy_limits_export) != length(.smart31_years$future) * length(expected_assessment_stocks) ||
    anyNA(fmsy_limits_export) || anyDuplicated(fmsy_limits_export[c("assessment_stock", "YEAR")]))
  smart31_stop("Incomplete or ambiguous assessment FMSY diagnostic export.")
used_limits <- step2_export$fmsy_catch_limits
if (is.null(used_limits)) used_limits <- step2_export$metadata$fmsy_catch_limits
if (!is.data.frame(used_limits)) smart31_stop("Step 2 overview does not contain the FMSY limits actually used.")
kk <- function(x) paste(x$assessment_stock, x$YEAR)
assert_unique(used_limits, c("assessment_stock", "YEAR"), "Step 2 FMSY limits")
if (!setequal(unique(used_limits$assessment_stock), step2_export$metadata$enforced_fmsy_stocks))
  smart31_stop("Original Step 2 constrained-stock scope differs from the retained raw assessment scope.")
previous_limits <- fmsy_limits_export %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$assessment_stock %in% used_limits$assessment_stock)
jj <- match(kk(previous_limits), kk(used_limits))
if (anyNA(jj) || nrow(used_limits) != nrow(previous_limits))
  smart31_stop("Original Step 2 / Step 3 FMSY stock-year coverage differs.")
for (nm in c("quota_kg", "Fmsy", "F_external_floor", "anchor_2025_t", "maximum_future_to_anchor_ratio")) {
  aa <- as.numeric(previous_limits[[nm]]); bb <- as.numeric(used_limits[[nm]][jj])
  if (any(!is.finite(bb)) || any(abs(aa-bb) > 1e-7*pmax(1,abs(bb))))
    smart31_stop("Original Step 2 / Step 3 FMSY mismatch: ", nm)
}
fmsy_limits_export$constrained_in_completed_Step2 <-
  fmsy_limits_export$assessment_stock %in% used_limits$assessment_stock
fmsy_limits_export$interpretation <- ifelse(fmsy_limits_export$constrained_in_completed_Step2,
  "Reproduced original Step 2 limit", "Post-hoc diagnostic limit; NOT applied to completed simulations")
fmsy_export_path <- path.expand(cfg$fmsy_limits_export_file)
dir.create(dirname(fmsy_export_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(fmsy_limits_export, fmsy_export_path, row.names = FALSE)
smart31_kable(fmsy_limits_export %>% dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR == .smart31_years$future_start),
  digits = 6, caption = smart31_report_label("Equivalent catch bounds: original constraints and post-hoc diagnostics (2027)"))
```

## Calibrated assessment F

```{r step3-16-calibrated-assessment-f}

assessment_catch_mapping <- eligible_catches %>%
  dplyr::mutate(assessment_GSA_parent = normalise_gsa_parent(.data$GSA_code)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(assessment_stock_crosswalk %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$Species, .data$GSA_code, .data$assessment_stock, .data$assessment_label),
    by = c("Species", "assessment_GSA_parent" = "GSA_code"), relationship = "many-to-one")
assessment_unmapped_catch_diagnostic <- assessment_catch_mapping %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(.data$assessment_stock), .data$landed_weight_kg > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate, .data$Species, .data$GSA_code) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(catch_kg = sum(.data$landed_weight_kg), .groups = "drop")
assessment_stock_catches_by_run <- assessment_catch_mapping %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$assessment_stock)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$scenario_year,
    .data$representative_period,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$member_state,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    SMART_future_landings_t = sum(.data$landed_weight_kg) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    controlled_anchor_2025 %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$raw_step1_landings_t,
        .data$fdi_harmonised_landings_t
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    future_vs_2025_ratio =
      .data$SMART_future_landings_t /
      .data$fdi_harmonised_landings_t,
    ratio_valid =
      is.finite(.data$future_vs_2025_ratio) &
      .data$future_vs_2025_ratio >= 0
  )

assessment_run_coverage <- tidyr::crossing(
  eligible_run_status %>% dplyr::distinct(.data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate),
  assessment_stock = expected_assessment_stocks) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(assessment_stock_catches_by_run,
    by = c("scenario_id", "method", "replicate", "assessment_stock"))
if (nrow(assessment_run_coverage)) {
  print(assessment_run_coverage)
  smart31_stop("An assessment stock has no archived catch support in at least one eligible run.")
}
if (any(!assessment_stock_catches_by_run$ratio_valid)) {
  print(assessment_stock_catches_by_run)
  smart31_stop(smart31_report_label("At least one future/2025 SMART landing ratio is invalid."))
}

f_at_age_calibrated_all <- assessment_stock_catches_by_run %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    anchor_age_state %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$calibration,
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$assessment_label,
        .data$Age,
        .data$Fbar_age_min,
        .data$Fbar_age_max,
        .data$Fmsy,
        .data$q_used,
        .data$q_used_valid,
        .data$M_reference_2025,
        .data$F_total_anchor_2025,
        .data$F_ITA_anchor_2025,
        .data$F_external_anchor_2025
      ),
    by = c("assessment_stock", "assessment_label"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

calibration_roots <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(
    ratio = f_at_age_calibrated_all$future_vs_2025_ratio,
    F_ITA_anchor = f_at_age_calibrated_all$F_ITA_anchor_2025,
    M = f_at_age_calibrated_all$M_reference_2025,
    F_external = f_at_age_calibrated_all$F_external_anchor_2025
  ),
  function(ratio, F_ITA_anchor, M, F_external) {
    solve_relative_partial_f(
      ratio = ratio,
      F_ITA_anchor = F_ITA_anchor,
      M = M,
      F_external = F_external,
      maximum_partial_F = as.numeric(cfg$maximum_F),
      tolerance = as.numeric(cfg$calibration_root_tolerance)
    )
  }
)

f_at_age_calibrated_all <- dplyr::bind_cols(
  f_at_age_calibrated_all,
  calibration_roots
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    F_external = F_external_anchor_2025,
    F_total = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$calibration_status %in% c("ok", "ok_zero_ratio"),
      .data$F_external + .data$F_ITA_future,
      NA_real_
    ),
    representative_year_start = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$baseline,
      .smart31_years$baseline,
      .smart31_years$future_start
    ),
    representative_year_end = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$baseline,
      .smart31_years$baseline,
      .smart31_years$future_end
    ),
    F_units = "annual_instantaneous_rate",
    temporal_semantics = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$baseline,
      "annual_representative_vector_for_2026",
      "one_annual_representative_vector_reused_for_2027_2030"
    ),
    F_interpretation =
      "calibrated_total_assessment_F_conditional_on_fixed_2025_stock_state",
    high_F_flag =
      is.finite(.data$F_total) &
      .data$F_total > as.numeric(cfg$high_F_warning_threshold),
    calibration_valid =
      .data$q_used_valid &
      .data$calibration_status %in% c("ok", "ok_zero_ratio") &
      is.finite(.data$F_total) &
      .data$F_total >= 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$calibration,
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$Age
  )

f_at_age_calibrated <- f_at_age_calibrated_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$calibration == .smart31_case$calibration_id
  )

calibrated_future_audit <- f_at_age_calibrated_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$calibration,
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$representative_period,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    future_vs_2025_ratio =
      one_value(.data$future_vs_2025_ratio, smart31_report_label("future/2025 landing ratio")),
    Fbar_age_projection_valid = all(
      .data$calibration_valid[
        .data$Age >= .data$Fbar_age_min &
        .data$Age <= .data$Fbar_age_max
      ]
    ),
    full_age_vector_valid = all(.data$calibration_valid),
    n_invalid_age_values = sum(!.data$calibration_valid),
    minimum_future_F_total = safe_min(.data$F_total),
    maximum_future_F_total = safe_max(.data$F_total),
    maximum_abs_root_residual =
      safe_max(abs(.data$calibration_root_residual)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

main_calibrated_future_audit <- calibrated_future_audit %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$calibration == .smart31_case$calibration_id
  )

if (any(
  !main_calibrated_future_audit$Fbar_age_projection_valid |
  !main_calibrated_future_audit$full_age_vector_valid
)) {
  print(main_calibrated_future_audit)
  smart31_stop(
    "At least one main-calibration future assessment F vector failed."
  )
}

assessment_f_indicators_all <- f_at_age_calibrated_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_Fbar_age_range =
      .data$Age >= .data$Fbar_age_min &
      .data$Age <= .data$Fbar_age_max
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$calibration,
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$scenario_year,
    .data$representative_period,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$member_state,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label,
    .data$Fbar_age_min,
    .data$Fbar_age_max,
    .data$Fmsy
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_Fbar_ages_expected =
      .data$Fbar_age_max[[1L]] - .data$Fbar_age_min[[1L]] + 1L,
    n_Fbar_ages_available = sum(
      .data$in_Fbar_age_range &
      .data$calibration_valid
    ),
    Fbar_candidate = if (
      any(.data$in_Fbar_age_range & .data$calibration_valid)
    ) {
      mean(
        .data$F_total[
          .data$in_Fbar_age_range &
          .data$calibration_valid
        ]
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    Fbar_ITA = if (
      any(.data$in_Fbar_age_range & .data$calibration_valid)
    ) {
      mean(
        .data$F_ITA_future[
          .data$in_Fbar_age_range &
          .data$calibration_valid
        ]
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    Fbar_external = if (
      any(.data$in_Fbar_age_range & .data$calibration_valid)
    ) {
      mean(
        .data$F_external[
          .data$in_Fbar_age_range &
          .data$calibration_valid
        ]
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    q_used = one_value(.data$q_used, "calibration share"),
    future_vs_2025_ratio = one_value(
      .data$future_vs_2025_ratio,
      smart31_report_label("future/2025 landing ratio")
    ),
    Fbar_2025 = mean(
      .data$F_total_anchor_2025[
        .data$in_Fbar_age_range
      ]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Fbar = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$n_Fbar_ages_available ==
        .data$n_Fbar_ages_expected,
      .data$Fbar_candidate,
      NA_real_
    ),
    F_over_Fmsy = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(.data$Fbar) &
      is.finite(.data$Fmsy) &
      .data$Fmsy > 0,
      .data$Fbar / .data$Fmsy,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Fbar_status = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$n_Fbar_ages_available ==
        .data$n_Fbar_ages_expected,
      "complete",
      "incomplete_age_range"
    )
  )

assessment_f_indicators <- assessment_f_indicators_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$calibration == .smart31_case$calibration_id
  )

fmsy_inverse_audit <- assessment_f_indicators %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$future,
    .data$scenario_year == .smart31_years$future_start) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(fmsy_limits_export %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$YEAR == .smart31_years$future_start) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$assessment_stock, fmsy_bound_kg = .data$quota_kg),
    by = "assessment_stock", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(controlled_anchor_2025 %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$assessment_stock, .data$fdi_harmonised_landings_t),
    by = "assessment_stock", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scenario_stock_catch_kg =
      1000 * .data$future_vs_2025_ratio * .data$fdi_harmonised_landings_t,
    catch_above_bound = .data$scenario_stock_catch_kg > .data$fmsy_bound_kg * (1 + 1e-8) + sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
    F_above_Fmsy = .data$Fbar > .data$Fmsy + 1e-8,
    inverse_consistent = .data$catch_above_bound == .data$F_above_Fmsy)
if (!nrow(fmsy_inverse_audit) || anyNA(fmsy_inverse_audit$inverse_consistent) ||
    !all(fmsy_inverse_audit$inverse_consistent)) {
  print(fmsy_inverse_audit)
  smart31_stop("FMSY inverse does not reproduce Step 3 status on previous Step 2 results.")
}
fmsy_inverse_audit$constrained_in_completed_Step2 <-
  fmsy_inverse_audit$assessment_stock %in% used_limits$assessment_stock
if (any(fmsy_inverse_audit$F_above_Fmsy & fmsy_inverse_audit$constrained_in_completed_Step2))
  smart31_stop("An originally constrained stock exceeds its FMSY bound.")

step2_stock_audit <- step2_export$fmsy_constraint_audit
if(!is.data.frame(step2_stock_audit)) smart31_stop("Final Step 2 F audit is missing.")
step2_step3_stock_audit <- fmsy_inverse_audit %>%
 dplyr::filter(.data$constrained_in_completed_Step2) %>%
 dplyr::left_join(step2_stock_audit %>% dplyr::select(.data$scenario_id,.data$method,.data$replicate,
 .data$assessment_stock,step2_catch_kg=.data$scenario_catch_kg,step2_F=.data$F_calibrated),
 by=c("scenario_id","method","replicate","assessment_stock"),relationship="one-to-one") %>%
 dplyr::mutate(catch_matches=is.finite(.data$step2_catch_kg) &
 abs(.data$scenario_stock_catch_kg-.data$step2_catch_kg)<=1e-8*pmax(1,.data$step2_catch_kg),
 F_matches=is.finite(.data$step2_F) & abs(.data$Fbar-.data$step2_F)<=1e-7)
if(anyNA(step2_step3_stock_audit$catch_matches) || anyNA(step2_step3_stock_audit$F_matches) ||
 !all(step2_step3_stock_audit$catch_matches & step2_step3_stock_audit$F_matches))
 smart31_stop("Step 2 and Step 3 do not reproduce the same stock catches / F.")
utils::write.csv(step2_step3_stock_audit,file.path(cfg$output_directory,"SMART31_Step2_Step3_stock_F_audit.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
smart31_kable(fmsy_inverse_audit %>%
  dplyr::select(.data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate,
    .data$assessment_stock, .data$scenario_stock_catch_kg,
    .data$fmsy_bound_kg, .data$F_over_Fmsy, .data$inverse_consistent),
  digits = 6, caption = "FMSY status of completed runs: exceedances are retained")

assessment_f_sensitivity <- assessment_f_indicators_all %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$calibration,
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$representative_period,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label,
    .data$q_used,
    .data$Fbar
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = .data$calibration,
    values_from = c(q_used, Fbar)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    absolute_Fbar_sensitivity_difference =
      .data$Fbar_q_2024_landings_share_sensitivity -
      .data$Fbar_median_2022_2024_landings_share,
    relative_Fbar_sensitivity_difference = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(.data$Fbar_median_2022_2024_landings_share) &
      .data$Fbar_median_2022_2024_landings_share != 0,
      .data$absolute_Fbar_sensitivity_difference /
        .data$Fbar_median_2022_2024_landings_share,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

smart31_kable(
  assessment_f_indicators,
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Authoritative calibrated assessment-stock F indicators"
)
```

## Calibrated fleet F by gear

```{r step3-17-calibrated-fleet-f-by-gear}

assessment_catch_at_age_by_gear <- catch_at_age_by_gear %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    assessment_stock_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$stock_id,
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$assessment_label
      ),
    by = "stock_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_age_parameters %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$stock_id,
        .data$representative_period,
        .data$Age,
        .data$mean_weight_kg,
        .data$landings_to_dead_removals_multiplier
      ),
    by = c("stock_id", "representative_period", "Age"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dead_removal_numbers_gear =
      .data$landed_weight_at_age_kg *
      .data$landings_to_dead_removals_multiplier /
      .data$mean_weight_kg
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$representative_period,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$assessment_label,
    .data$Age,
    .data$Gear
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dead_removal_numbers_gear =
      sum(.data$dead_removal_numbers_gear),
    landed_weight_at_age_kg =
      sum(.data$landed_weight_at_age_kg),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_dead_removal_numbers_ITA =
      sum(.data$dead_removal_numbers_gear),
    dead_removal_share_gear = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$total_dead_removal_numbers_ITA > 0,
      .data$dead_removal_numbers_gear /
        .data$total_dead_removal_numbers_ITA,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

gear_decomposition_coverage <- tibble::tibble(
  assessment_stock = expected_assessment_stocks,
  gear_specific_F_available = expected_assessment_stocks %in% raw_assessment_stocks,
  note = ifelse(expected_assessment_stocks %in% raw_assessment_stocks,
    "Existing spatial age and gear allocation retained",
    "Total and Italian assessment F available; gear-specific F not calculated"))
missing_calibrated_gear_keys <- f_at_age_calibrated %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$F_ITA_future > 0, .data$assessment_stock %in% raw_assessment_stocks) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$representative_period,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$Age
  ) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(
    assessment_catch_at_age_by_gear %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$total_dead_removal_numbers_ITA > 0) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        .data$scenario_id,
        .data$method,
        .data$replicate,
        .data$representative_period,
        .data$contract_scenario_code,
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$Age
      ),
    by = c(
      "scenario_id", "method", "replicate",
      "representative_period", "contract_scenario_code",
      "assessment_stock", "Age"
    )
  )

if (nrow(missing_calibrated_gear_keys) > 0L) {
  print(missing_calibrated_gear_keys)
  smart31_stop(
    "A positive calibrated Italian F-at-age row has no gear-removal support."
  )
}

calibrated_ita_f_by_gear <- assessment_catch_at_age_by_gear %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    f_at_age_calibrated %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$scenario_id,
        .data$method,
        .data$replicate,
        .data$representative_period,
        .data$contract_scenario_code,
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$Age,
        .data$F_ITA_future,
        .data$F_external,
        .data$F_total,
        .data$calibration_status
      ),
    by = c(
      "scenario_id", "method", "replicate",
      "representative_period", "contract_scenario_code",
      "assessment_stock", "Age"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    F_ITA_partial_gear =
      .data$F_ITA_future * .data$dead_removal_share_gear,
    F_component_interpretation =
      "Italian calibrated partial F by gear; external F is not assigned to Italian gears"
  )

calibrated_ita_f_gear_reconciliation <- calibrated_ita_f_by_gear %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$Age
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    F_ITA = one_value(.data$F_ITA_future, "calibrated Italian F"),
    sum_F_ITA_by_gear = sum(.data$F_ITA_partial_gear),
    absolute_error =
      abs(.data$F_ITA - .data$sum_F_ITA_by_gear),
    reconciled =
      .data$absolute_error <=
        as.numeric(cfg$partial_f_tolerance_fraction) *
        pmax(1, abs(.data$F_ITA)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (anyNA(calibrated_ita_f_gear_reconciliation$reconciled) ||
    any(!calibrated_ita_f_gear_reconciliation$reconciled)) {
  print(calibrated_ita_f_gear_reconciliation)
  smart31_stop(
    "Calibrated Italian gear-specific F does not reconcile to the calibrated Italian component."
  )
}
```

## Calibration promotion audit

```{r step3-18-calibration-promotion-audit}

calibration_promotion_audit <- controlled_anchor_2025 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    share_calibration %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$q_ref_valid
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    continuity_summary %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$calibration ==
          .smart31_case$calibration_id
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        continuity_pass = continuity_pass
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    main_calibrated_future_audit %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$assessment_stock) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        all_future_Fbar_valid =
          all(.data$Fbar_age_projection_valid),
        all_future_age_vectors_valid =
          all(.data$full_age_vector_valid),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "assessment_stock",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    calibration_2024_valid =
      isTRUE(validation_2024_summary$calibration_rule_reproduces_2024),
    independent_calibration_reproduced =
      all(calibration_regression_audit$regression_match),
    matched_FDI_coverage_complete =
      is.finite(.data$fdi_matched_coverage_fraction) &
      abs(.data$fdi_matched_coverage_fraction - 1) <= 1e-12,
    no_2025_logbook_only =
      .data$n_logbook_only_strata == 0L,
    no_2025_FDI_only =
      .data$n_fdi_only_strata == 0L,
    gear_decomposition_available = .data$assessment_stock %in% raw_assessment_stocks,
    calibrated_gear_F_reconciled = ifelse(.data$gear_decomposition_available,
      all(calibrated_ita_f_gear_reconciliation$reconciled), NA),
    promotion_pass =
      .data$calibration_2024_valid &
      .data$independent_calibration_reproduced &
      .data$matched_FDI_coverage_complete &
      .data$no_2025_logbook_only &
      .data$no_2025_FDI_only &
      .data$q_ref_valid &
      .data$continuity_pass &
      .data$all_future_Fbar_valid &
      .data$all_future_age_vectors_valid &
      (!.data$gear_decomposition_available | dplyr::coalesce(.data$calibrated_gear_F_reconciled, FALSE))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    promotion_status = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$promotion_pass,
      "PASS",
      "FAIL"
    )
  )

if (nrow(calibration_promotion_audit) != length(expected_assessment_stocks) ||
    any(!calibration_promotion_audit$promotion_pass)) {
  print(calibration_promotion_audit)
  smart31_stop(
    "Assessment-scale F calibration promotion audit failed."
  )
}

smart31_kable(
  calibration_promotion_audit,
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Assessment-scale calibrated-F promotion audit"
)
```

## Biological audit and method sensitivity

```{r step3-19-biological-audit-and-method-sensitivity}

reference_method <- as.character(cfg$method_sensitivity_reference_method)
comparison_method <- as.character(cfg$method_sensitivity_comparison_method)
methods_available <- sort(unique(eligible_run_status$method))

method_sensitivity_at_age <- tibble::tibble(
  scenario_id = character(),
  assessment_stock = character(),
  assessment_label = character(),
  Age = integer(),
  reference_method = character(),
  comparison_method = character(),
  F_reference = numeric(),
  F_comparison = numeric(),
  absolute_difference = numeric(),
  relative_difference_percent = numeric()
)

method_sensitivity_fbar <- tibble::tibble(
  scenario_id = character(),
  assessment_stock = character(),
  assessment_label = character(),
  reference_method = character(),
  comparison_method = character(),
  Fbar_reference = numeric(),
  Fbar_comparison = numeric(),
  absolute_difference = numeric(),
  relative_difference_percent = numeric()
)

if (all(c(reference_method, comparison_method) %in% methods_available)) {
  method_sensitivity_at_age <- f_at_age_calibrated %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$method %in% c(reference_method, comparison_method)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$scenario_id,
      .data$assessment_stock,
      .data$assessment_label,
      .data$Age,
      .data$method
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      F = if (all(.data$calibration_valid)) {
        mean(.data$F_total)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = .data$method,
      values_from = .data$F,
      names_prefix = "F__"
    )

  ref_col <- paste0("F__", reference_method)
  cmp_col <- paste0("F__", comparison_method)

  method_sensitivity_at_age$reference_method <- reference_method
  method_sensitivity_at_age$comparison_method <- comparison_method
  method_sensitivity_at_age$F_reference <-
    method_sensitivity_at_age[[ref_col]]
  method_sensitivity_at_age$F_comparison <-
    method_sensitivity_at_age[[cmp_col]]
  method_sensitivity_at_age$absolute_difference <-
    method_sensitivity_at_age$F_comparison -
    method_sensitivity_at_age$F_reference
  method_sensitivity_at_age$relative_difference_percent <-
    safe_percent_change(
      method_sensitivity_at_age$F_comparison,
      method_sensitivity_at_age$F_reference
    )

  method_sensitivity_fbar <- assessment_f_indicators %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$method %in% c(reference_method, comparison_method)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$scenario_id,
      .data$assessment_stock,
      .data$assessment_label,
      .data$method
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Fbar = mean(.data$Fbar, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Fbar = dplyr::if_else(
        is.nan(.data$Fbar),
        NA_real_,
        .data$Fbar
      )
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = .data$method,
      values_from = .data$Fbar,
      names_prefix = "Fbar__"
    )

  ref_col <- paste0("Fbar__", reference_method)
  cmp_col <- paste0("Fbar__", comparison_method)

  method_sensitivity_fbar$reference_method <- reference_method
  method_sensitivity_fbar$comparison_method <- comparison_method
  method_sensitivity_fbar$Fbar_reference <-
    method_sensitivity_fbar[[ref_col]]
  method_sensitivity_fbar$Fbar_comparison <-
    method_sensitivity_fbar[[cmp_col]]
  method_sensitivity_fbar$absolute_difference <-
    method_sensitivity_fbar$Fbar_comparison -
    method_sensitivity_fbar$Fbar_reference
  method_sensitivity_fbar$relative_difference_percent <-
    safe_percent_change(
      method_sensitivity_fbar$Fbar_comparison,
      method_sensitivity_fbar$Fbar_reference
    )
}

    continuity_main_ok,
    calibrated_future_ok && calibrated_main_rows_ok,
    calibrated_gear_partition_ok,
    all(c(reference_method, comparison_method) %in% methods_available)
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ready_for_downstream =
      all(.data$passed[.data$critical])
  )

n_extended_unique_cells <- dplyr::n_distinct(

)

n_unresolved_unique_cells <- missing_age_profile_diagnostic %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data$GSA_code,
    .data$Species,
    .data$id_grid
  ) %>%
  nrow()

biological_warning_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  diagnostic = c(
    "raw_ITA_proxy_F_above_warning_threshold",
    "calibrated_total_F_above_warning_threshold",
    "raw_dead_removal_fraction_above_warning_threshold",
    "positive_catch_strata_outside_raw_age_scope",
    "raw_Baranov_residual_above_tolerance_rows",
    "raw_Baranov_dead_removals_not_below_starting_abundance_rows",
    "historical_landing_share_outside_0_1_rows",
    "FDI_only_target_strata_2025",
    "unique_step2_catch_cells_reconstructed_from_step1_age_model",
    "unique_mapped_catch_cells_still_without_age_profile"
  ),
  n = c(
    sum(f_at_age$high_F_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(f_at_age_calibrated$high_F_flag, na.rm = TRUE),

    ),
    sum(historical_landing_share$q_out_of_bounds, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(controlled_anchor_2025$n_fdi_only_strata, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_extended_unique_cells,
    n_unresolved_unique_cells
  ),
  threshold = c(
    as.character(cfg$high_F_warning_threshold),
    as.character(cfg$high_F_warning_threshold),
    as.character(cfg$dead_removal_fraction_warning_threshold),
    "Raw spatial-age scope only; consult assessment_unmapped_catches for assessment coverage gaps",
    paste0(
      "critical numerical diagnostic: relative residual <= ",

    ),

    "diagnostic: historical Italian landings share should remain within [0,1]",
    "critical calibration diagnostic: must be zero for target stocks",

    ),
    "critical coverage diagnostic: must be zero for downstream readiness"
  )
)

smart31_kable(
```

## Reporting compliance

```{r step3-20-reporting-compliance}

stock_fmsy_compliance <- assessment_f_indicators %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    constrained_in_completed_Step2 = .data$assessment_stock %in% used_limits$assessment_stock &
      .data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$future,
    FMSY_respected = is.finite(.data$F_over_Fmsy) & .data$F_over_Fmsy <= 1 + 1e-8,
    FMSY_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.finite(.data$F_over_Fmsy) ~ "NOT_EVALUABLE",
      .data$FMSY_respected ~ "AT_OR_BELOW_FMSY",
      TRUE ~ "ABOVE_FMSY"),
    evaluation_year = ifelse(.data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$future, .smart31_years$future_start, .smart31_years$baseline),
    interpretation = "Postprocessing of frozen simulations; no catch, effort or F rescaling")
scenario_fmsy_compliance <- stock_fmsy_compliance %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$representative_period == .smart31_case$periods$future) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$scenario_id, .data$method, .data$replicate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_assessed_stocks = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$assessment_stock),
    n_exceeding_FMSY = sum(.data$FMSY_status == "ABOVE_FMSY"),
    n_not_evaluable = sum(.data$FMSY_status == "NOT_EVALUABLE"),
    all_assessed_stocks_meet_FMSY = n_assessed_stocks == length(expected_assessment_stocks) &
      all(.data$FMSY_respected),
    exceeding_stocks = paste(.data$assessment_stock[.data$FMSY_status == "ABOVE_FMSY"], collapse = "; "),
    contract_all_stocks_compliance_demonstrated = all_assessed_stocks_meet_FMSY &
      !length(.smart31_case$reporting$catch_only_stock_ids) & nrow(assessment_unmapped_catch_diagnostic)==0L,
    scope_note = paste("Catch-only stocks:", paste(.smart31_case$reporting$catch_only_stock_ids,collapse=", "), "; catches outside assessment scope remain explicit"),
    .groups = "drop")
raw_biological_failure_detail <- f_at_age %>%
  dplyr::filter(!.data$baranov_status %in% c("ok", "ok_zero_catch")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(removals_to_N_ratio = .data$dead_removal_numbers / .data$N_start,
    minimum_capacity_shortfall_kg = pmax(0, .data$dead_removal_numbers - .data$N_start) * .data$mean_weight_kg,
    diagnostic_note = "Raw pressure inversion failed; N, catch and age allocation unchanged; downstream gate remains failed")
smart31_kable(scenario_fmsy_compliance, caption = smart31_report_label("2027 FMSY compliance of the available scenarios"))
smart31_kable(stock_fmsy_compliance %>% dplyr::select(.data$scenario_id, .data$method,
  .data$replicate, .data$assessment_stock, .data$Fbar, .data$Fmsy, .data$F_over_Fmsy,
  .data$FMSY_status, .data$constrained_in_completed_Step2), digits = 6)
smart31_kable(raw_biological_failure_detail, caption = "Unresolved raw biological failures; no automatic repair")
smart31_kable(gear_decomposition_coverage, caption = "Scope of gear-specific F estimates")
cat("\nAssessment-only stock coverage: ", paste(posthoc_assessment_stocks,collapse=", "),
    ". Postprocessing does not alter completed catch, effort or economic outcomes. ",
    "FMSY bounds depend on calibration and fixed external mortality. ",
    "Between-method ranges describe algorithmic sensitivity, not confidence intervals.\n",sep="")
```
