## Verify single stock advice

```{r step3-21-verify-single-stock-advice}

catch_only_ids <- .smart31_case$reporting$catch_only_stock_ids
if (length(catch_only_ids)) {
  catch_only_reference <- stock_reference_points %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$stock_id %in% catch_only_ids) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(assessment_stock=.data$stock_id, assessment_label=.data$stock_label,
      single_stock_advice_catch_t_2027=.data$single_stock_advice_catch_t_2027,
      single_stock_advice_F_Fmsy_2027=NA_real_, single_stock_advice_SSB_t_2027=NA_real_,
      Bpa_t=.data$Bpa_t, Blim_t=.data$Blim_t)
  if (!setequal(catch_only_reference$assessment_stock,catch_only_ids) ||
      any(catch_only_ids %in% expected_assessment_stocks))
    smart31_stop("Catch-only stock IDs must be covered by reference points and separate from assessed stocks.")
  assessment_reference_points <- dplyr::bind_rows(assessment_reference_points,catch_only_reference)
  catch_only_catches <- stock_catches_by_run %>% dplyr::filter(.data$stock_id %in% catch_only_ids) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(.data$scenario_id,.data$scenario_year,.data$representative_period,
      .data$contract_scenario_code,.data$member_state,.data$method,.data$replicate,
      assessment_stock=.data$stock_id,SMART_future_landings_t=.data$catch_t) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(catch_only_reference %>% dplyr::select(.data$assessment_stock,.data$assessment_label),
      by="assessment_stock",relationship="many-to-one")
  assessment_stock_catches_by_run <- dplyr::bind_rows(assessment_stock_catches_by_run,catch_only_catches)
}
single_stock_advice_target_year <- .smart31_years$future_start
single_stock_advice_path <- path.expand(
  as.character(cfg$single_stock_advice_file)
)
if (length(single_stock_advice_path) != 1L ||
    is.na(single_stock_advice_path) || !nzchar(single_stock_advice_path)) {
  smart31_stop("params$single_stock_advice_file must identify one optional CSV input.")
}

advice_metric_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~metric, ~legacy_field, ~expected_unit,
  "catch_t", "single_stock_advice_catch_t_2027", "t",
  "F_Fmsy", "single_stock_advice_F_Fmsy_2027", "ratio",
  "SSB_t", "single_stock_advice_SSB_t_2027", "t"
)
advice_keys <- c("assessment_stock", "metric")
advice_stock_keys <- assessment_reference_points %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$assessment_stock, .data$assessment_label)

single_stock_advice_template <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  assessment_stock = advice_stock_keys$assessment_stock,
  metric = advice_metric_map$metric
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(advice_metric_map, by = "metric", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$metric,
    value = NA_real_,
    unit = .data$expected_unit,
    advice_year = single_stock_advice_target_year,
    source_publication_year = NA_integer_,
    source_document = NA_character_,
    source_locator = NA_character_,
    advice_basis = NA_character_,
    scope = "ASSESSMENT_STOCK",
    verification_status = "PENDING_VERIFICATION"
  )

single_stock_advice_from_file <- file.exists(single_stock_advice_path)
if (single_stock_advice_from_file) {
  single_stock_advice_raw <- read_contract_csv(
    single_stock_advice_path,
    names(single_stock_advice_template),
    "Documented single-stock advice"
  )
} else {
  single_stock_advice_raw <- single_stock_advice_template
}

parse_advice_number <- function(x, field, integer_required = FALSE) {
  text_value <- trimws(as.character(x))
  missing_value <- is.na(x) | toupper(text_value) %in% c("", "NA", "N/A")
  parsed <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(text_value))
  invalid <- !missing_value & (!is.finite(parsed) | parsed < 0)
  if (integer_required) {
    invalid <- invalid | (!missing_value & is.finite(parsed) & parsed != trunc(parsed))
  }
  if (any(invalid)) {
    smart31_stop("Invalid numeric value in single-stock advice field: ", field, ".")
  }
  parsed[missing_value] <- NA_real_
  parsed
}

single_stock_advice_input <- single_stock_advice_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(names(single_stock_advice_template))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c(
        "assessment_stock", "metric", "unit", "source_document",
        "source_locator", "advice_basis", "scope", "verification_status"
      )),
      ~ trimws(as.character(.x))
    ),
    value = parse_advice_number(.data$value, "value"),
    advice_year = parse_advice_number(.data$advice_year, "advice_year", TRUE),
    source_publication_year = parse_advice_number(
      .data$source_publication_year, "source_publication_year", TRUE
    ),
    verification_status = toupper(.data$verification_status),
    scope = toupper(.data$scope)
  )

if (anyNA(single_stock_advice_input$assessment_stock) ||
    any(!single_stock_advice_input$assessment_stock %in% advice_stock_keys$assessment_stock) ||
    anyNA(single_stock_advice_input$metric) ||
    any(!single_stock_advice_input$metric %in% advice_metric_map$metric)) {
  smart31_stop("Single-stock advice contains missing or unknown assessment-stock/metric keys.")
}
assert_unique(single_stock_advice_input, advice_keys, "Documented single-stock advice")

legacy_single_stock_advice <- assessment_reference_points %>%
  dplyr::select(.data$assessment_stock, dplyr::all_of(advice_metric_map$legacy_field)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(advice_metric_map$legacy_field),
    names_to = "legacy_field", values_to = "legacy_value_unverified"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(advice_metric_map, by = "legacy_field", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(advice_keys), .data$legacy_value_unverified)

advice_has_text <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(x)) & !toupper(trimws(x)) %in% c("NA", "N/A")
}

single_stock_advice_audit <- single_stock_advice_template %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(advice_keys)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(advice_stock_keys, by = "assessment_stock", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(advice_metric_map, by = "metric", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(single_stock_advice_input, by = advice_keys, relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(legacy_single_stock_advice, by = advice_keys, relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    target_year = single_stock_advice_target_year,
    source_file_present = single_stock_advice_from_file,
    documented_value_present = is.finite(.data$value),
    target_year_matches = dplyr::coalesce(.data$advice_year == .data$target_year, FALSE),
    unit_matches = dplyr::coalesce(.data$unit == .data$expected_unit, FALSE),
    assessment_scope_matches = dplyr::coalesce(.data$scope == "ASSESSMENT_STOCK", FALSE),
    provenance_complete = is.finite(.data$source_publication_year) &
      .data$source_publication_year >= 1900 &
      .data$source_publication_year <= .data$target_year &
      advice_has_text(.data$source_document) &
      advice_has_text(.data$source_locator) &
      advice_has_text(.data$advice_basis),
    explicitly_verified = dplyr::coalesce(.data$verification_status == "VERIFIED", FALSE),
    include_in_annex = .data$source_file_present & .data$documented_value_present &
      .data$target_year_matches & .data$unit_matches & .data$assessment_scope_matches &
      .data$provenance_complete & .data$explicitly_verified,
    status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$include_in_annex ~ "VERIFIED_FOR_2027",
      !.data$documented_value_present & is.finite(.data$legacy_value_unverified) ~
        "LEGACY_VALUE_WITHOUT_VERIFIED_2027_SOURCE",
      !.data$documented_value_present ~ "NO_VERIFIED_VALUE_SUPPLIED",
      !.data$target_year_matches ~ "WRONG_OR_MISSING_ADVICE_YEAR",
      !.data$unit_matches ~ "UNIT_MISMATCH",
      !.data$assessment_scope_matches ~ "ASSESSMENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH",
      !.data$provenance_complete ~ "INCOMPLETE_PROVENANCE",
      TRUE ~ "NOT_EXPLICITLY_VERIFIED"
    ),
    published_advice_value = dplyr::if_else(.data$include_in_annex, .data$value, NA_real_),
    note = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$include_in_annex,
      "Included using explicitly verified, documented target-year advice.",
      "Annex advice cell left blank. This does not imply zero advice or that no official advice exists."
    )
  )

validated_single_stock_advice <- single_stock_advice_audit %>%
  dplyr::select(.data$assessment_stock, .data$legacy_field, .data$published_advice_value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "legacy_field", values_from = "published_advice_value")

annex_reference_points <- assessment_reference_points %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of(advice_metric_map$legacy_field)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(validated_single_stock_advice, by = "assessment_stock", relationship = "one-to-one")

single_stock_advice_source_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  target_year = single_stock_advice_target_year,
  configured_file = single_stock_advice_path,
  file_present = single_stock_advice_from_file,
  md5 = if (single_stock_advice_from_file) unname(tools::md5sum(single_stock_advice_path)) else NA_character_,
  verified_cells = sum(single_stock_advice_audit$include_in_annex),
  blank_cells = sum(!single_stock_advice_audit$include_in_annex),
  policy = "No legacy fallback; publication year and advice year are distinct; each metric needs documented verification."
)

cat(
  smart31_report_label("Single-stock advice for 2027: "), sum(single_stock_advice_audit$include_in_annex),
  " verified cells; ", sum(!single_stock_advice_audit$include_in_annex),
  " blank cells. See Advice_status in each biological Annex workbook.\n", sep = ""
)
smart31_kable(
  single_stock_advice_audit %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$assessment_label, .data$metric, .data$legacy_value_unverified,
      .data$value, .data$advice_year, .data$published_advice_value, .data$status
    ),
  caption = smart31_report_label("Single-stock advice: verified 2027 values and reasons for blank Annex cells")
)
```

```{r step3-22-annex-biological-tables}
    .data$SSB_t
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    assessment_anchor_2025 %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        .data$assessment_stock,
        .data$assessment_label,
        Year = .data$Year,
        .data$SSB_t
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$assessment_stock,
    .data$Year
  )

smart31_kable(
  annex_table_4_1,
  digits = 3,
  caption =
    smart31_report_label("Annex II Table 4.1 — total catches by management scenario for 2027; SMART columns A/B represent the Italian mapped component")
)

smart31_kable(
  annex_table_4_2,
  digits = 3,
  caption =
    smart31_report_label("Annex II Table 4.2 — resulting calibrated assessment F/Fmsy in 2027")
)

smart31_kable(
  annex_table_4_3,
  digits = 3,
  caption =
    "Annex II Table 4.3 — SSB interface; scenario values are returned by Maelstrom"
)
```

## Annex F target control

```{r step3-23-annex-f-target-control}

annex_f_target_path <- path.expand(
  as.character(cfg$annex_f_target_file)
)

annex_f_target_from_file <- file.exists(
  annex_f_target_path
)

if (annex_f_target_from_file) {
  annex_f_target_input <- read_contract_csv(
    annex_f_target_path,
    c(
      "EMU",
      "assessment_stock",
      "target_type",
      "target_F_value",
      "official_2027_target",
      "source",
      "note"
    ),
    "EMU2 Annex F-target diagnostic"
  )
} else {
  if (!isTRUE(cfg$allow_missing_annex_f_target_file)) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Annex F-target file not found: ",
      annex_f_target_path
    )
  }

  smart31_stop("An explicit Annex F-target diagnostic input is required; no stock is selected by default.")
}

annex_f_target_input <- annex_f_target_input %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    EMU = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data$EMU))),
    assessment_stock =
      trimws(as.character(.data$assessment_stock)),
    target_type =
      trimws(as.character(.data$target_type)),
    target_F_value =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$target_F_value)),
    official_2027_target =
      tolower(trimws(as.character(.data$official_2027_target))) %in%
      c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y"),
    source = as.character(.data$source),
    note = as.character(.data$note)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$EMU == .smart31_case$reporting$emu)

if (nrow(annex_f_target_input) == 0L) {
  annex_f_target_input <- tibble::tibble(
    EMU = .smart31_case$reporting$emu,
    assessment_stock = NA_character_,
    target_type = NA_character_,
    target_F_value = NA_real_,
    official_2027_target = FALSE,
    source = "No EMU2 target supplied",
    note = "diagnostic not evaluable; non-limiting"
  )
}

if (nrow(annex_f_target_input) > 1L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The Annex F-target input must contain at most one EMU2 target row."
  )
}

target_stock_id <-
  annex_f_target_input$assessment_stock[[1L]]

target_reference <- assessment_reference_points %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$assessment_stock == target_stock_id
  )

if (nrow(target_reference) == 1L &&
    !is.finite(
      annex_f_target_input$target_F_value[[1L]]
    ) &&
    tolower(
      annex_f_target_input$target_type[[1L]]
    ) == "fmsy") {
  annex_f_target_input$target_F_value[[1L]] <-
    target_reference$Fmsy[[1L]]
}

target_f_by_method <- assessment_f_indicators %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$assessment_stock == target_stock_id,
    .data$contract_scenario_code %in% c("A", "B")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    resulting_Fbar =
      median_or_na(.data$Fbar),
    resulting_F_over_Fmsy =
      median_or_na(.data$F_over_Fmsy),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

target_control_methods <-
  sort(
    unique(
      eligible_run_status$method
    )
  )

annex_f_target_control_all_methods <-
  tidyr::crossing(
    annex_f_target_input,
    contract_scenario_code = c("A", "B"),
    method = target_control_methods
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    target_f_by_method,
    by = c(
      "contract_scenario_code",
      "method"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    target_to_result_ratio =
      dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(.data$target_F_value) &
          .data$target_F_value > 0 &
          is.finite(.data$resulting_Fbar),
        .data$resulting_Fbar /
          .data$target_F_value,
        NA_real_
      ),
    resulting_minus_target =
      dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(.data$target_F_value) &
          is.finite(.data$resulting_Fbar),
        .data$resulting_Fbar -
          .data$target_F_value,
        NA_real_
      ),
    position_relative_to_target =
      dplyr::case_when(
        !is.finite(.data$target_F_value) |
          !is.finite(.data$resulting_Fbar) ~
          "NOT_EVALUABLE",
        .data$resulting_Fbar <=
          .data$target_F_value ~
          "AT_OR_BELOW_TARGET",
        TRUE ~
          "ABOVE_TARGET"
      ),
    control_effect =
      "DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NON_LIMITING"
  )

annex_f_target_control <-
  annex_f_target_control_all_methods %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$method ==
      contract_summary_method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$EMU,
    `Most vulnerable stock` =
      .data$assessment_stock,
    `Target type` =
      .data$target_type,
    `Target F` =
      .data$target_F_value,
    `Official 2027 target` =
      .data$official_2027_target,
    Scenario =
      .data$contract_scenario_code,
    `Resulting Fbar` =
      .data$resulting_Fbar,
    `Resulting F/Fmsy` =
      .data$resulting_F_over_Fmsy,
    `Resulting F / target F` =
      .data$target_to_result_ratio,
    `Resulting F - target F` =
      .data$resulting_minus_target,
    `Position relative to target` =
      .data$position_relative_to_target,
    `Control effect` =
      .data$control_effect,
    Source =
      .data$source,
    Note =
      .data$note
  )

smart31_kable(
  annex_f_target_control,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "EMU2 most-vulnerable-stock F-target diagnostic;",
    "reported only and never used as a Step 2/Step 3 constraint"
  )
)
```

## Load final economic audit

```{r step3-24-load-final-economic-audit}

economic_audit_path <- path.expand(
  as.character(cfg$economic_impact_audit_file)
)

if (dir.exists(economic_audit_path)) {
  economic_audit_candidates <- list.files(
    economic_audit_path,
    pattern = "^SMART31_economic_impact_audit_[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{6}\\.rds$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (!length(economic_audit_candidates)) {
    smart31_stop("No economic impact audit RDS found in: ", economic_audit_path)
  }
  target_step2_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(step2_result_file))
  compatible <- vapply(economic_audit_candidates, function(file) {
    meta <- tryCatch(readRDS(file)$metadata, error = function(e) NULL)
    identical(as.character(meta$step2_md5), target_step2_md5) &&
      identical(as.character(meta$step1_md5), configured_step1_md5) &&
      identical(as.character(meta$version), as.character(cfg$expected_economic_impact_audit_version))
  }, logical(1))
  economic_audit_candidates <- economic_audit_candidates[compatible]
  if (!length(economic_audit_candidates))
    smart31_stop("No economic audit matches the selected Step 2 result. Run scripts/run_workflow.R economic_audit.")
  economic_audit_path <- economic_audit_candidates[[
    order(basename(economic_audit_candidates), decreasing = TRUE)[[1L]]
  ]]
}

if (!file.exists(economic_audit_path)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Final economic impact audit not found: ",
    economic_audit_path
  )
}

economic_audit <- readRDS(
  economic_audit_path
)

if (!is.list(economic_audit) ||
    is.null(economic_audit$metadata) ||
    is.null(economic_audit$tables)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The selected economic impact audit has an invalid structure."
  )
}

economic_audit_version <-
  as.character(
    economic_audit$metadata$version %||%
      NA_character_
  )

if (!identical(
  economic_audit_version,
  as.character(
    cfg$expected_economic_impact_audit_version
  )
)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Unexpected economic-impact audit version. Expected ",
    cfg$expected_economic_impact_audit_version,
    "; observed ",
    economic_audit_version,
    "."
  )
}

if (!identical(
  as.character(
    economic_audit$metadata$step1_md5 %||%
      NA_character_
  ),
  configured_step1_md5
)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Economic audit / Step 1 provenance mismatch."
  )
}

step2_md5_current <-
  unname(
    tools::md5sum(
      step2_result_file
    )
  )

if (!identical(
  as.character(
    economic_audit$metadata$step2_md5 %||%
      NA_character_
  ),
  step2_md5_current
)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Economic audit / Step 2 provenance mismatch."
  )
}

required_economic_audit_tables <- c(
  "annex_economic_outputs",
  "mapped_rates_recent",
  "gear_impact",
  "vessel_impact",
  "decision_audit",
  "archive_audit"
)

missing_economic_audit_tables <-
  setdiff(
    required_economic_audit_tables,
    names(economic_audit$tables)
  )

if (length(missing_economic_audit_tables) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Final economic audit is missing tables: ",
    paste(
      missing_economic_audit_tables,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

economic_decision <-
  tibble::as_tibble(
    economic_audit$tables$decision_audit
  )

economic_final_status <-
  economic_decision %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$diagnostic ==
      "Final interpretation"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data$status)

if (length(economic_final_status) != 1L ||
    !identical(
      economic_final_status,
      "NO_FULL_STEP2_RERUN_INDICATED_BY_THIS_AUDIT"
    )) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The selected economic audit is not the validated no-rerun final state."
  )
}

economic_archive_audit <-
  tibble::as_tibble(
    economic_audit$tables$archive_audit
  )

if (!all(
  economic_archive_audit$
    all_reconstruction_gates_pass
)) {
  smart31_stop(
    "The final economic audit does not pass all Step 2 reconstruction gates."
  )
}

economic_annex_by_run <-
  tibble::as_tibble(
    economic_audit$tables$annex_economic_outputs
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scenario_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$scenario_id,
        .data$contract_scenario_code
      ),
    by = "scenario_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    member_state = .smart31_case$domain$country
  )

assert_columns(
  economic_annex_by_run,
  c(
    "scenario_id",
    "contract_scenario_code",
    "method",
    "replicate",
    "GVA_SMART_posthoc_eur",
    "GP_SMART_posthoc_eur",
    "GPM_SMART_posthoc",
    "estimated_FTE_reference"
  ),
  "Final economic Annex layer"
)

target_catch_by_run <- stock_catches_by_run %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$target_stock) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    target_landings_t =
      sum(.data$catch_t),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scenario_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$scenario_id,
        .data$contract_scenario_code
      ),
    by = "scenario_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

tor4_run_performance <-
  economic_annex_by_run %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    target_catch_by_run %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$scenario_id,
        .data$method,
        .data$replicate,
        .data$target_landings_t
      ),
    by = c(
      "scenario_id",
      "method",
      "replicate"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  )

if (any(!is.finite(
  tor4_run_performance$target_landings_t
))) {
  smart31_stop(
    "TOR4 target landings are incomplete after joining the final economic audit."
  )
}

baseline_tor4 <-
  tor4_run_performance %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$contract_scenario_code ==
      .smart31_case$scenario_codes$baseline
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    baseline_target_landings_t =
      .data$target_landings_t,
    baseline_GPM =
      .data$GPM_SMART_posthoc,
    baseline_FTE =
      .data$estimated_FTE_reference,
    baseline_GVA =
      .data$GVA_SMART_posthoc_eur
  )

short_term_by_run <-
  tor4_run_performance %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$contract_scenario_code %in%
      c("A", "B")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_tor4,
    by = c(
      "method",
      "replicate"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    target_landings_change_pct =
      safe_percent_change(
        .data$target_landings_t,
        .data$baseline_target_landings_t
      ),
    gross_profit_margin_change_pct =
      safe_percent_change(
        .data$GPM_SMART_posthoc,
        .data$baseline_GPM
      ),
    FTE_change_pct =
      safe_percent_change(
        .data$estimated_FTE_reference,
        .data$baseline_FTE
      ),
    supplemental_GVA_change_pct =
      safe_percent_change(
        .data$GVA_SMART_posthoc_eur,
        .data$baseline_GVA
      )
  )

short_term_central <-
  short_term_by_run %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$method ==
      contract_summary_method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$contract_scenario_code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    target_landings_change_pct =
      median_or_na(
        .data$target_landings_change_pct
      ),
    gross_profit_margin_change_pct =
      median_or_na(
        .data$gross_profit_margin_change_pct
      ),
    FTE_change_pct =
      median_or_na(
        .data$FTE_change_pct
      ),
    supplemental_GVA_change_pct =
      median_or_na(
        .data$supplemental_GVA_change_pct
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

annex_table_5 <-
  tibble::tibble(
    Scenarios =
      c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    MS = .smart31_case$domain$country
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    short_term_central %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        Scenarios =
          .data$contract_scenario_code
      ),
    by = "Scenarios",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$Scenarios,
    .data$MS,
    `Estimated variation of landings of target species (% change 2026-2027)` =
      .data$target_landings_change_pct,
    `Estimated variation of profitability (% change of gross profit margin 2026-2027)` =
      .data$gross_profit_margin_change_pct,
    `Estimated variation of employment (% change of on-board FTE 2026-2027)` =
      .data$FTE_change_pct
  )

smart31_kable(
  annex_table_5,
  digits = 2,
  caption =
    "Annex II Table 5 — Italian short-term socio-economic outputs"
)
```

## Annex long term table

```{r step3-25-annex-long-term-table}

assert_columns(
  step1_inputs$IBM,
  c(
    "YEAR",
    "GSA_code",
    "Species",
    "W"
  ),
  "Step 1 IBM"
)

historical_target_landings <-
  step1_inputs$IBM %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    YEAR =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          as.character(.data$YEAR)
        )
      ),
    GSA_code =
      normalise_gsa_parent(
        .data$GSA_code
      ),
    Species =
      normalise_code(
        .data$Species
      ),
    landed_weight_kg =
      as.numeric(.data$W)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    stock_area_crosswalk,
    by = c(
      "Species",
      "GSA_code"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$stock_id),
    .data$target_stock
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    target_landings_t =
      sum(.data$landed_weight_kg) /
      1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mapped_candidate_rates <-
  tibble::as_tibble(
    economic_audit$tables$
      mapped_rates_recent
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Gear =
      normalise_code(.data$Gear),
    VL =
      normalise_code(.data$VL),
    candidate_OC_share =
      as.numeric(.data$OC_share),
    candidate_LC_share =
      as.numeric(.data$LC_share),
    candidate_FTE_per_active_vessel =
      as.numeric(
        .data$FTE_per_active_vessel
      )
  )

assert_unique(
  mapped_candidate_rates,
  c("Gear", "VL"),
  "Economic-audit candidate-rate mapping"
)

assert_columns(
  step1_inputs$IBM.eco.annual,
  c(
    "CFR",
    "YEAR",
    "Gear",
    "VL",
    "days_at_sea",
    "GVL",
    "EC"
  ),
  "Step 1 IBM.eco.annual"
)

historical_candidate_economics <-
  step1_inputs$IBM.eco.annual %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    CFR =
      trimws(
        as.character(.data$CFR)
      ),
    YEAR =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          as.character(.data$YEAR)
        )
      ),
    Gear =
      normalise_code(.data$Gear),
    VL =
      normalise_code(.data$VL),
    days_at_sea =
      as.numeric(.data$days_at_sea),
    GVL =
      as.numeric(.data$GVL),
    EC =
      as.numeric(.data$EC)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    mapped_candidate_rates,
    by = c("Gear", "VL"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

historical_missing_candidate_rates <-
  historical_candidate_economics %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(.data$GVL),
    .data$GVL > 1e-12,
    (
      !is.finite(
        .data$candidate_OC_share
      ) |
      !is.finite(
        .data$candidate_LC_share
      ) |
      !is.finite(
        .data$candidate_FTE_per_active_vessel
      )
    )
  )

if (nrow(
  historical_missing_candidate_rates
) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Historical Step 1 economics contain positive-GVL Gear-VL rows without final candidate rates."
  )
}

historical_candidate_economics <-
  historical_candidate_economics %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OC_candidate =
      .data$GVL *
      .data$candidate_OC_share,
    LC_candidate =
      .data$GVL *
      .data$candidate_LC_share
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$CFR,
    .data$YEAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    vessel_year_days =
      sum(
        dplyr::coalesce(
          .data$days_at_sea,
          0
        )
      ),
    vessel_year_GVL =
      sum(
        dplyr::coalesce(
          .data$GVL,
          0
        )
      ),
    FTE_weight =
      dplyr::case_when(
        .data$vessel_year_days > 0 ~
          dplyr::coalesce(
            .data$days_at_sea,
            0
          ) /
          .data$vessel_year_days,
        .data$vessel_year_GVL > 0 ~
          dplyr::coalesce(
            .data$GVL,
            0
          ) /
          .data$vessel_year_GVL,
        TRUE ~
          1 / dplyr::n()
      ),
    FTE_component =
      .data$FTE_weight *
      .data$candidate_FTE_per_active_vessel
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

historical_candidate_annual <-
  historical_candidate_economics %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$YEAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    GVL =
      sum(.data$GVL),
    EC =
      sum(.data$EC),
    OC_candidate =
      sum(.data$OC_candidate),
    LC_candidate =
      sum(.data$LC_candidate),
    FTE_candidate =
      sum(.data$FTE_component),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    GP_candidate =
      .data$GVL -
      .data$EC -
      .data$OC_candidate -
      .data$LC_candidate,
    GPM_candidate =
      dplyr::if_else(
        .data$GVL > 0,
        .data$GP_candidate /
          .data$GVL,
        NA_real_
      )
  )

historical_years_available <-
  sort(
    Reduce(
      intersect,
      list(
        .smart31_years$history_start:.smart31_years$anchor,
        historical_target_landings$YEAR,
        historical_candidate_annual$YEAR
      )
    )
  )

if (length(
  historical_years_available
) == 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "No common historical year is available for the final Table 6 calculation."
  )
}

historical_landings_sum <-
  sum(
    historical_target_landings$
      target_landings_t[
        historical_target_landings$
          YEAR %in%
          historical_years_available
      ]
  )

historical_gpm_sum <-
  sum(
    historical_candidate_annual$
      GPM_candidate[
        historical_candidate_annual$
          YEAR %in%
          historical_years_available
      ]
  )

historical_fte_sum <-
  sum(
    historical_candidate_annual$
      FTE_candidate[
        historical_candidate_annual$
          YEAR %in%
          historical_years_available
      ]
  )

baseline_for_long_term <-
  tor4_run_performance %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$contract_scenario_code ==
      .smart31_case$scenario_codes$baseline
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    average_target_landings_2020_2026 =
      (
        historical_landings_sum +
        .data$target_landings_t
      ) /
      (
        length(
          historical_years_available
        ) + 1
      ),
    average_GPM_2020_2026 =
      (
        historical_gpm_sum +
        .data$GPM_SMART_posthoc
      ) /
      (
        length(
          historical_years_available
        ) + 1
      ),
    average_FTE_2020_2026 =
      (
        historical_fte_sum +
        .data$estimated_FTE_reference
      ) /
      (
        length(
          historical_years_available
        ) + 1
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$average_target_landings_2020_2026,
    .data$average_GPM_2020_2026,
    .data$average_FTE_2020_2026
  )

audit_gear_impact <-
  tibble::as_tibble(
    economic_audit$tables$gear_impact
  )

audit_vessel_impact <-
  tibble::as_tibble(
    economic_audit$tables$vessel_impact
  )

green_join_keys <- c(
  "scenario_id",
  "scenario_year",
  "representative_period",
  "member_state",
  "cm_status",
  "method",
  "replicate",
  "CFR"
)

green_segment_by_run <-
  audit_gear_impact %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    audit_vessel_impact %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(
          green_join_keys
        ),
        vessel_EC = .data$EC
      ),
    by = green_join_keys,
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    allocated_physical_EC =
      .data$vessel_EC *
      .data$gear_day_share,
    segment_GP_component =
      .data$GVL_rec -
      .data$allocated_physical_EC -
      .data$new_OC -
      .data$new_LC
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$VL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    segment_GP =
      sum(
        .data$segment_GP_component
      ),
    n_vessels =
      dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    green_positive_GP =
      .data$segment_GP > 0
  )

green_count_by_run <-
  green_segment_by_run %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_green_segments =
      sum(
        .data$green_positive_GP
      ),
    total_segments =
      dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scenario_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$scenario_id,
        .data$contract_scenario_code
      ),
    by = "scenario_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

baseline_green <-
  green_count_by_run %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$contract_scenario_code ==
      .smart31_case$scenario_codes$baseline
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    baseline_green_segments =
      .data$n_green_segments
  )

long_term_by_run <-
  tor4_run_performance %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$contract_scenario_code %in%
      c("A", "B")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_for_long_term,
    by = c(
      "method",
      "replicate"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    green_count_by_run %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$scenario_id,
        .data$method,
        .data$replicate,
        future_green_segments =
          .data$n_green_segments
      ),
    by = c(
      "scenario_id",
      "method",
      "replicate"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_green,
    by = c(
      "method",
      "replicate"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    target_landings_change_pct =
      safe_percent_change(
        .data$target_landings_t,
        .data$average_target_landings_2020_2026
      ),
    gross_profit_margin_change_pct =
      safe_percent_change(
        .data$GPM_SMART_posthoc,
        .data$average_GPM_2020_2026
      ),
    FTE_change_pct =
      safe_percent_change(
        .data$estimated_FTE_reference,
        .data$average_FTE_2020_2026
      ),
    green_segments_avg_2026_2030 =
      (
        .data$baseline_green_segments +
        4 *
        .data$future_green_segments
      ) / 5
  )

long_term_central <-
  long_term_by_run %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$method ==
      contract_summary_method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$contract_scenario_code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    target_landings_change_pct =
      median_or_na(
        .data$target_landings_change_pct
      ),
    gross_profit_margin_change_pct =
      median_or_na(
        .data$gross_profit_margin_change_pct
      ),
    FTE_change_pct =
      median_or_na(
        .data$FTE_change_pct
      ),
    green_segments_avg_2026_2030 =
      median_or_na(
        .data$green_segments_avg_2026_2030
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

annex_table_6 <-
  tibble::tibble(
    Scenarios =
      c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    MS = .smart31_case$domain$country
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    long_term_central %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        Scenarios =
          .data$contract_scenario_code
      ),
    by = "Scenarios",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$Scenarios,
    .data$MS,
    `Estimated variation of landings of target species (% change AVG(2020-2026)-2030)` =
      .data$target_landings_change_pct,
    `Estimated variation of profitability (% change of gross profit margin AVG(2020-2026)-2030)` =
      .data$gross_profit_margin_change_pct,
    `Estimated variation of employment (% change of on-board FTE AVG(2020-2026)-2030)` =
      .data$FTE_change_pct,
    `Estimated number of fleet segments in green (AVG 2026-2030)` =
      .data$green_segments_avg_2026_2030
  )

tor4_methodology_audit <-
  tibble::tibble(
    item = c(
      "Economic input",
      "Profitability metric",
      "Energy cost",
      "OC / LC",
      "Employment",
      "Historical Table 6 account",
      "Green fleet segment",
      "C / D handling"
    ),
    final_rule = c(
      paste0(
        "Economic impact audit ",
        economic_audit_version
      ),
      "Gross profit margin (GP/GVL)",
      "Frozen physical Step 2 / Step 1 EC",
      smart31_report_label("Pooled 2022-2024 candidate reference"),
      "Reference-based on-board FTE; gear mix weighted by realised days",
      paste0(
        "2020-",
        max(
          historical_years_available
        ),
        smart31_report_label(" Step 1 GVL/EC re-accounted with candidate OC/LC/FTE; 2026 from final audit")
      ),
      paste(
        "positive GP at Gear x VL scale;",
        "physical vessel EC allocated by realised gear-day share"
      ),
      "No separate SMART C/D rows; blank Annex cells/rows because Maelstrom integrates biological uncertainty stochastically"
    )

smart31_kable(
  annex_table_6,

    "Annex II Table 6 — Italian long-term performance outputs"
)
```

## Effort support table

```{r step3-26-effort-support-table}

assert_columns(
  step2_export$spatial_patterns,
  c(
    "scenario_id",
    "method",
    "replicate",
    "CFR",
    "MONTH",
    "Gear",
    "loa",
    "days_at_sea"
  ),
  "Step 2 spatial patterns"
)

effort_source_eligible <-
  step2_export$spatial_patterns %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(
    eligible_run_status,
    by = run_keys
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scenario_crosswalk %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$scenario_id,
        .data$contract_scenario_code
      ),
    by = "scenario_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$contract_scenario_code %in%
      c("A", "B")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CFR_original = as.character(.data$CFR),
    CFR = normalise_cfr(.data$CFR),
    Gear = normalise_code(.data$Gear)
  )

invalid_emu2_otb_cfr <-
  effort_source_eligible %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$Gear == "OTB",
    is.na(.data$CFR)
  )

if (nrow(invalid_emu2_otb_cfr) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "Eligible A/B OTB effort rows contain CFR values that cannot be matched to the controlled ARA/ARS authorisation list."
  )
}

invalid_emu2_otb_values <- effort_source_eligible %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$Gear == "OTB",
                !is.finite(.data$loa) | .data$loa <= 0 |
                !is.finite(.data$days_at_sea) | .data$days_at_sea < 0)
if (nrow(invalid_emu2_otb_values) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop("EMU2 effort reporting requires positive finite LOA and finite non-negative days_at_sea for every OTB spatial row.")
}

step2_emu2_otb_vessels <-
  effort_source_eligible %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$Gear == "OTB") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$CFR) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(in_frozen_step2_emu2_otb = TRUE)

ara_ars_authorization_match_detail <-
  dplyr::full_join(
    ara_ars_authorized_vessels %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        CFR = .data$CFR,
        in_authorized_2026_list = TRUE,
        authorization_source_year = .data$source_year,
        authorization_source_decree = .data$source_decree,
        authorization_pdf_page = .data$pdf_page
      ),
    step2_emu2_otb_vessels,
    by = "CFR",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_authorized_2026_list = dplyr::coalesce(.data$in_authorized_2026_list, FALSE),
    in_frozen_step2_emu2_otb = dplyr::coalesce(.data$in_frozen_step2_emu2_otb, FALSE),
    match_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$in_authorized_2026_list & .data$in_frozen_step2_emu2_otb ~
        "AUTHORIZED_MATCHED",
      .data$in_authorized_2026_list ~
        "AUTHORIZED_NOT_IN_FROZEN_STEP2",
      TRUE ~
        "POLYSPECIFIC_NOT_IN_AUTHORIZED_LIST"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$match_status, .data$CFR)

if (!any(
  ara_ars_authorization_match_detail$match_status ==
    "AUTHORIZED_MATCHED"
)) {
  smart31_stop(
    smart31_report_label("No frozen Step 2 OTB vessel matches the controlled 2026 ARA/ARS authorisation list.")
  )
}

ara_ars_authorization_match_summary <-
  ara_ars_authorization_match_detail %>%
  dplyr::count(.data$match_status, name = "n_vessels") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    match_status = c(
      "AUTHORIZED_MATCHED",
      "AUTHORIZED_NOT_IN_FROZEN_STEP2",
      "POLYSPECIFIC_NOT_IN_AUTHORIZED_LIST"
    ),
    fill = list(n_vessels = 0L)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$match_status)

ara_ars_authorization_effort_audit_by_run <-
  effort_source_eligible %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$Gear == "OTB") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    authorized_ARA_ARS_2026 =
      .data$CFR %in% ara_ars_authorized_vessels$CFR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_OTB_vessels = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR),
    authorized_OTB_vessels = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR[.data$authorized_ARA_ARS_2026]),
    polyspecific_OTB_vessels = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CFR[!.data$authorized_ARA_ARS_2026]),
    total_OTB_fishing_days = sum(.data$days_at_sea),
    authorized_OTB_fishing_days = sum(.data$days_at_sea[.data$authorized_ARA_ARS_2026]),
    polyspecific_OTB_fishing_days = sum(.data$days_at_sea[!.data$authorized_ARA_ARS_2026]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

effort_by_vessel_gear <-
  effort_source_eligible %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$Gear == "OTB") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effort_group = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$CFR %in% ara_ars_authorized_vessels$CFR,
      .smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[1L]],
      .smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[2L]]
    ),
    fishing_effort_group_code = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$effort_group == .smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[1L]],
      .smart31_case$reporting$effort_group_codes[[1L]],
      .smart31_case$reporting$effort_group_codes[[2L]]
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$scenario_id,
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$CFR,
    .data$MONTH,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$effort_group,
    .data$fishing_effort_group_code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    loa =
      one_value(
        .data$loa,
        "vessel LOA"
      ),
    fishing_days =
      sum(.data$days_at_sea),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    loa_band =
      dplyr::case_when(
        .data$loa < 12 ~ "<12m",
        .data$loa < 18 ~ "≥ 12 m and < 18 m",
        .data$loa < 24 ~ "≥ 18 m and < 24 m",
        TRUE ~ "≥ 24 m"
      )
  )

annex_final_advice_support_by_run <-
  effort_by_vessel_gear %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$method,
    .data$replicate,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$effort_group,
    .data$fishing_effort_group_code,
    .data$loa_band
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    member_state = .smart31_case$domain$country,
    absolute_fishing_days =
      sum(.data$fishing_days),
    n_vessels =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        .data$CFR
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

annex_final_advice_support <-
  annex_final_advice_support_by_run %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$contract_scenario_code,
    .data$member_state,
    .data$Gear,
    .data$effort_group,
    .data$fishing_effort_group_code,
    .data$loa_band
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    absolute_fishing_days =
      median_or_na(
        .data$absolute_fishing_days
      ),
    n_vessels =
      median_or_na(
        .data$n_vessels
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

effort_interval_methods <- c("bayesian_dirichlet", "stochastic_optimizer")
effort_length_bands <- c("<12m", "≥ 12 m and < 18 m", "≥ 18 m and < 24 m", "≥ 24 m")
effort_group_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  effort_group = c(.smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[1L]], .smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[2L]]),
  loa_band = effort_length_bands
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fishing_effort_group_code = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$effort_group == .smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[1L]], .smart31_case$reporting$effort_group_codes[[1L]], .smart31_case$reporting$effort_group_codes[[2L]]
    )
  )

if (!contract_summary_method %in% effort_interval_methods) {
  smart31_stop("EMU2 effort reporting requires contract_summary_method to be bayesian_dirichlet or stochastic_optimizer.")
}

effort_interval_runs <- eligible_run_status %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$contract_scenario_code %in% c("A", "B"),
                .data$method %in% effort_interval_methods) %>%
  dplyr::select(.data$scenario_id, .data$contract_scenario_code, .data$method,
                .data$replicate, .data$feasible, .data$converged)
assert_unique(effort_interval_runs, c("contract_scenario_code", "method", "replicate"),
              "EMU2 effort interval run keys")

if (nrow(effort_interval_runs) == 0L || anyNA(effort_interval_runs$replicate)) {
  smart31_stop("No complete eligible A/B method runs are available for EMU2 effort ranges.")
}
effort_expected_runs <- tidyr::crossing(
  contract_scenario_code = c("A", "B"),
  method = effort_interval_methods,
  replicate = sort(unique(effort_interval_runs$replicate))
)
effort_missing_runs <- dplyr::anti_join(
  effort_expected_runs, effort_interval_runs,
  by = c("contract_scenario_code", "method", "replicate")
)
if (nrow(effort_missing_runs) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop(
    "EMU2 effort ranges require both eligible methods in A and B for each replicate. Missing: ",
    paste(apply(as.data.frame(effort_missing_runs), 1L, paste, collapse = "/"), collapse = "; "),
    ". Check run eligibility and include_feasible_nonconverged; no missing result is replaced by zero."
  )
}

effort_interval_observed <- annex_final_advice_support_by_run %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$Gear == "OTB", .data$method %in% effort_interval_methods)
assert_unique(
  effort_interval_observed,
  c("contract_scenario_code", "method", "replicate", "effort_group", "loa_band"),
  "EMU2 effort by method/run/group/length"
)
if (any(!is.finite(effort_interval_observed$absolute_fishing_days)) ||
    any(effort_interval_observed$absolute_fishing_days < 0)) {
  smart31_stop("EMU2 effort ranges require finite, non-negative fishing days in every observed row.")
}
effort_runs_without_otb <- dplyr::anti_join(
  effort_interval_runs, effort_interval_observed,
  by = c("contract_scenario_code", "method", "replicate")
)
if (nrow(effort_runs_without_otb) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop("An eligible A/B method run has no OTB effort detail. Restore its spatial patterns before calculating effort ranges.")
}

effort_cohort <- effort_by_vessel_gear %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$method %in% effort_interval_methods) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$contract_scenario_code, .data$replicate, .data$method,
                  .data$CFR, .data$loa_band, .data$effort_group)
effort_cohort_keys <- c("contract_scenario_code", "replicate", "CFR", "loa_band", "effort_group")
effort_cohort_bd <- dplyr::filter(effort_cohort, .data$method == "bayesian_dirichlet")
effort_cohort_so <- dplyr::filter(effort_cohort, .data$method == "stochastic_optimizer")
if (nrow(dplyr::anti_join(effort_cohort_bd, effort_cohort_so, by = effort_cohort_keys)) > 0L ||
    nrow(dplyr::anti_join(effort_cohort_so, effort_cohort_bd, by = effort_cohort_keys)) > 0L) {
  smart31_stop("The two methods use different OTB vessel/length cohorts within an A/B scenario. Reconcile the cohort before calculating the method range.")
}

effort_interval_by_run <- tidyr::crossing(effort_interval_runs, effort_group_grid) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    effort_interval_observed %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$contract_scenario_code, .data$method, .data$replicate,
                    .data$effort_group, .data$loa_band, .data$absolute_fishing_days,
                    .data$n_vessels) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(stratum_present = TRUE),
    by = c("contract_scenario_code", "method", "replicate", "effort_group", "loa_band"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    structural_zero = is.na(.data$stratum_present),
    absolute_fishing_days = dplyr::if_else(.data$structural_zero, 0, .data$absolute_fishing_days),
    n_vessels = dplyr::if_else(.data$structural_zero, 0L, as.integer(.data$n_vessels))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.data$stratum_present)

effort_method_estimates <- effort_interval_by_run %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$effort_group, .data$fishing_effort_group_code,
                  .data$loa_band, .data$method, .data$contract_scenario_code) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    fishing_days = median(.data$absolute_fishing_days),
    n_replicates = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$replicate),
    all_feasible = all(.data$feasible),
    all_converged = all(.data$converged),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = .data$contract_scenario_code,
    values_from = c("fishing_days", "n_replicates", "all_feasible", "all_converged"),
    names_glue = "{contract_scenario_code}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    additional_days_B_minus_A = .data$B_fishing_days - .data$A_fishing_days,
    effort_group_order = match(.data$effort_group, c(.smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[1L]], .smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[2L]])),
    loa_band_order = match(.data$loa_band, effort_length_bands)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$effort_group_order, .data$loa_band_order, .data$method)

effort_method_intervals <- effort_method_estimates %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$effort_group, .data$fishing_effort_group_code,
                  .data$loa_band, .data$effort_group_order, .data$loa_band_order) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    A_lower = min(.data$A_fishing_days),
    A_upper = max(.data$A_fishing_days),
    B_lower = min(.data$B_fishing_days),
    B_upper = max(.data$B_fishing_days),
    additional_days_lower = min(.data$additional_days_B_minus_A),
    additional_days_upper = max(.data$additional_days_B_minus_A),
    n_methods = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$method),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(interval_type = "BETWEEN_METHOD_MIN_MAX_NOT_CONFIDENCE_INTERVAL") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$effort_group_order, .data$loa_band_order)
if (any(effort_method_intervals$n_methods != 2L)) {
  smart31_stop("Every EMU2 effort interval must be based on exactly the two requested methods.")
}

effort_pair_central <- effort_method_estimates %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$method == contract_summary_method) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    effort_group = .data$effort_group,
    fishing_effort_group_code = .data$fishing_effort_group_code,
    loa_band = .data$loa_band,
    A = .data$A_fishing_days,
    B = .data$B_fishing_days,
    additional_days_B_minus_A = .data$additional_days_B_minus_A
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    effort_method_intervals,
    by = c("effort_group", "fishing_effort_group_code", "loa_band"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$effort_group_order, .data$loa_band_order)

effort_interval_reconciliation <- effort_interval_by_run %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$scenario_id, .data$contract_scenario_code, .data$method, .data$replicate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    completed_fishing_days = sum(.data$absolute_fishing_days),
    n_length_group_rows = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ara_ars_authorization_effort_audit_by_run %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$scenario_id, .data$contract_scenario_code, .data$method,
                    .data$replicate, .data$total_OTB_fishing_days),
    by = c("scenario_id", "contract_scenario_code", "method", "replicate"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    difference = .data$completed_fishing_days - .data$total_OTB_fishing_days,
    passed = is.finite(.data$difference) & .data$n_length_group_rows == 8L &
      abs(.data$difference) <= 1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(.data$total_OTB_fishing_days))
  )
if (!all(effort_interval_reconciliation$passed)) {
  smart31_stop("EMU2 effort interval rows do not reconcile with frozen Step 2 OTB run totals.")
}

effort_interval_notes <- c(
  "The added lower and upper bounds describe the minimum and maximum of the Bayesian-Dirichlet and Stochastic optimiser estimates. They are between-method sensitivity ranges, not statistical confidence intervals; no 95% coverage is claimed.",
  "The original Italy point estimate remains the contract_summary_method estimate. Method_estimates reports both algorithms separately. No averaging of the two methods is silently substituted into the contract estimate.",
  "For each method, fishing days are summed over vessel-month spatial allocations within stock group and length band, separately for each run. If several balanced replicates are present, the median run total is used within each method before calculating the between-method bounds.",
  "B-A is calculated within each method as its reported B estimate minus its reported A estimate. The lower and upper bounds of B-A are then calculated across these two differences; endpoints from different methods are never subtracted.",
  "A zero-width range means agreement between the two method estimates. It does not establish absence of sampling, model or biological uncertainty. Display rounding can conceal very small numerical differences.",
  "An absent group/length stratum is assigned zero only within a verified run containing OTB effort detail. A missing method, scenario or replicate stops interval calculation and is never treated as zero effort.",
  "Effort_by_run records the run values, structural zeros, feasibility and convergence flags. Feasible non-converged solutions remain eligible only under the existing include_feasible_nonconverged setting; a method range is not evidence of convergence.",
  "Bounds must not be summed across rows to calculate an aggregate bound. Aggregate fishing days within each method first, then take the minimum and maximum of the two aggregate estimates.",
  "The WITH_CM versus WITHOUT_CM comparison covers the complete scenario packages. B-A is not an isolated estimate of CM bonus-day uptake or a causal effect of compensation alone."
)

target_stock_display <-
  annex_f_target_control %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    `Most vulnerable stock`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    `Most vulnerable stock`
  )

if (length(target_stock_display) != 1L ||
    is.na(target_stock_display)) {
  target_stock_display <-
    "EMU2 target not supplied"
}

annex_emu2_no_cm <-
  effort_pair_central %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    `Stock group` = .data$effort_group,
    `Overall length of vessels` =
      .data$loa_band,
    `Member state fishing days` =
      .data$A,
    `Fishing effort group code` =
      .data$fishing_effort_group_code,
    `Lower between-method bound (days)` = .data$A_lower,
    `Upper between-method bound (days)` = .data$A_upper
  )

annex_emu2_with_cm <-
  effort_pair_central %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    `Stock group` = .data$effort_group,
    `Overall length of vessels` =
      .data$loa_band,
    `Total fishing days with CM` =
      .data$B,
    `Additional days B-A` =
      .data$additional_days_B_minus_A,
    `Additional allocation code` =
      .data$fishing_effort_group_code,
    `Total days lower method bound` = .data$B_lower,
    `Total days upper method bound` = .data$B_upper,
    `B-A lower method bound (days)` = .data$additional_days_lower,
    `B-A upper method bound (days)` = .data$additional_days_upper
  )

expected_emu2_effort_rows <- tidyr::crossing(
  `Stock group` = c(.smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[1L]], .smart31_case$reporting$effort_groups[[2L]]),
  `Overall length of vessels` = c(
    "<12m",
    "≥ 12 m and < 18 m",
    "≥ 18 m and < 24 m",
    "≥ 24 m"
  )
)

for (table_to_check in list(
  annex_emu2_no_cm,
  annex_emu2_with_cm
)) {
  observed_effort_rows <- table_to_check %>%
    dplyr::select(
      `Stock group`,
      `Overall length of vessels`
    )

  if (nrow(table_to_check) != 8L ||
      nrow(dplyr::anti_join(
        expected_emu2_effort_rows,
        observed_effort_rows,
        by = c("Stock group", "Overall length of vessels")
      )) > 0L) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Annex II EMU2 effort table does not contain the required eight stock-group × length-band rows."
    )
  }
}

smart31_kable(
  ara_ars_authorization_match_summary,
  caption =
    smart31_report_label("ARA/ARS 2026 authorisation match against frozen Step 2 A/B OTB vessels")
)

smart31_kable(

  caption =
    "Classification of realised OTB fishing days into ARA/ARS and polyspecific effort groups"
)

smart31_kable(
  annex_emu2_no_cm,
  digits = 2,
  caption = paste(
    "Annex II item 3 — EMU2 Italy no-CM realised SMART effort;",
    "non-binding F-target diagnostic"
  )
)

smart31_kable(
  annex_emu2_with_cm,
  digits = 2,
  caption = paste(
    "Annex II item 4 — EMU2 Italy with-CM realised SMART effort;",

)
```

```{r step3-33-save-step3-outputs}
  openxlsx::createStyle(
    textDecoration = "bold",
    fontSize = 13,

    valign = "center"

annex_note_style <-
  openxlsx::createStyle(
    wrapText = TRUE,
    valign = "top"
  )

estimate_column_widths <- function(
  table_value,
  minimum = 10,
  maximum = 42
) {
  if (ncol(table_value) == 0L) {
    return(numeric())
  }

  vapply(
    seq_len(
      ncol(table_value)
    ),
    function(j) {
      values <-
        c(
          names(table_value)[[j]],
          as.character(
            table_value[[j]]
          )
        )

      values <-
        values[
          !is.na(values)
        ]

      observed <-
        if (length(values) > 0L) {
          max(
            nchar(values),
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        } else {
          minimum
        }

      min(
        maximum,
        max(
          minimum,
          observed + 2
        )
      )
    },
    numeric(1)
  )
}

write_annex_workbook <- function(
  table_value,
  file_name,
  table_title,
  notes,
  extra_sheets = list()
) {
  file_name <- gsub("_scenario_year",paste0("_",.smart31_years$future_start),file_name,fixed=TRUE)
  file_name <- gsub("EMU2",.smart31_case$reporting$emu,file_name,fixed=TRUE)
  table_title <- smart31_report_label(table_title)
  notes <- smart31_report_label(notes)
  names(table_value) <- smart31_report_label(names(table_value))
  destination <-
    file.path(
      annex_xlsx_directory,
      file_name
    )

  workbook <-
    openxlsx::createWorkbook()

  openxlsx::addWorksheet(
    workbook,
    "Table"
  )

  openxlsx::writeData(
    workbook,
    "Table",
    table_title,
    startRow = 1,
    startCol = 1
  )

  openxlsx::addStyle(
    workbook,
    "Table",
    annex_title_style,
    rows = 1,
    cols = 1,
    gridExpand = TRUE
  )

  openxlsx::writeDataTable(
    workbook,
    "Table",
    table_value,
    startRow = 3,
    startCol = 1,
    withFilter = FALSE,
    tableStyle =
      "TableStyleMedium2"
  )

  openxlsx::freezePane(
    workbook,
    "Table",
    firstActiveRow = 4
  )

  if (ncol(table_value) > 0L) {
    openxlsx::setColWidths(
      workbook,
      "Table",
      cols =
        seq_len(
          ncol(table_value)
        ),
      widths =
        estimate_column_widths(
          table_value
        )
    )
  }

  is_emu2_effort_workbook <- grepl("^AnnexII_[34]_", file_name)
  if (is_emu2_effort_workbook) {
    openxlsx::mergeCells(workbook, "Table", cols = seq_len(ncol(table_value)), rows = 1)
    openxlsx::addStyle(workbook, "Table", annex_note_style, rows = 1,
                      cols = seq_len(ncol(table_value)), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setRowHeights(workbook, "Table", rows = 1, heights = 42)
    openxlsx::writeData(workbook, "Table",
      paste0("Point estimate: ", contract_summary_method,
             "; bounds: Bayesian-Dirichlet / Stochastic min-max (not a confidence interval)."),
      startRow = 2, colNames = FALSE)
    openxlsx::mergeCells(workbook, "Table", cols = seq_len(ncol(table_value)), rows = 2)
    openxlsx::addStyle(workbook, "Table", annex_note_style, rows = 2,
                      cols = seq_len(ncol(table_value)), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setRowHeights(workbook, "Table", rows = 2, heights = 32)
    openxlsx::addStyle(workbook, "Table", annex_note_style, rows = 3,
                      cols = seq_len(ncol(table_value)), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setRowHeights(workbook, "Table", rows = 3, heights = 44)
    numeric_columns <- which(vapply(table_value, is.numeric, logical(1)))
    if (length(numeric_columns) > 0L) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(workbook, "Table",
        openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "#,##0.00"),
        rows = seq_len(nrow(table_value)) + 3L, cols = numeric_columns,
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    }
  }

  openxlsx::addWorksheet(
    workbook,
    "Notes"
  )

  notes_table <-
    tibble::tibble(
      Note = as.character(
        notes
      )
    )

  openxlsx::writeData(
    workbook,
    "Notes",
    notes_table,
    colNames = TRUE
  )

  openxlsx::addStyle(
    workbook,
    "Notes",
    annex_note_style,
    rows =
      seq_len(
        nrow(notes_table) + 1L
      ),
    cols = 1,
    gridExpand = TRUE
  )

  openxlsx::setColWidths(
    workbook,
    "Notes",
    cols = 1,
    widths = 110
  )

  if (is_emu2_effort_workbook) {
    openxlsx::setRowHeights(workbook, "Notes", rows = seq_len(nrow(notes_table)) + 1L,
                          heights = pmax(30, 16 * ceiling(nchar(notes_table$Note) / 95)))
  }

  if (length(extra_sheets) > 0L) {
    for (
      extra_name in names(
        extra_sheets
      )
    ) {
      if (nchar(extra_name) > 31L) {
        smart31_stop(
          "Individual Annex workbook extra-sheet name exceeds 31 characters: ",
          extra_name
        )
      }

      openxlsx::addWorksheet(
        workbook,
        extra_name
      )

      openxlsx::writeDataTable(
        workbook,
        extra_name,
        extra_sheets[[extra_name]],
        withFilter = TRUE,
        tableStyle =
          "TableStyleMedium2"
      )

      openxlsx::freezePane(
        workbook,
        extra_name,
        firstRow = TRUE
      )

      if (ncol(
        extra_sheets[[extra_name]]
      ) > 0L) {
        openxlsx::setColWidths(
          workbook,
          extra_name,
          cols =
            seq_len(
              ncol(
                extra_sheets[[extra_name]]
              )
            ),
          widths =
            estimate_column_widths(
              extra_sheets[[extra_name]]
            )
        )
      }
    }
  }

  temporary_file <-
    tempfile(
      pattern =
        "SMART31_annex_table_",
      tmpdir =
        annex_xlsx_directory,
      fileext = ".xlsx"
    )

  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
    workbook,
    temporary_file,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  if (file.exists(destination)) {
    unlink(destination)
  }

  if (!file.rename(
    temporary_file,
    destination
  )) {
    smart31_stop(
      "Unable to publish individual Annex workbook: ",
      destination
    )
  }

  destination
}

  "A blank single-stock advice cell means no verified value has been supplied for that stock and metric. It does not mean zero advice or that official advice does not exist. Verified zero advice is shown as 0.",
```
